Have your 身份证 (shēnfènzhèng) or passport ready. Arriving at the station: 进站 (jìnzhàn), 安检 (ānjiǎn), 候车厅 (hòuchētīng), 检票 (jiǎnpiào) (ticket check), 上车 (shàngchē).
objectivesEn: Choose 高铁/动车/普快
Book via 12306 with 身份证
Navigate 进站 → 安检 → 候车厅 → 上车
Tell apart 硬座/软卧/二等座

cecr-b11-travel-m2.introTitleEn: Hotels in China: from check-in to check-out
cecr-b11-travel-m2.introContentEn:
At a restaurant or hotel, a few phrases and keywords are enough to get by.

- Hotel = 酒店 (jiǔdiàn) or 宾馆 (bīnguǎn).
- Hostel = 旅馆 (lǚguǎn).
- Reception = 前台 (qiántái).

On arrival: 我预订了一间 [X] 的房间，我的名字是 [...] (wǒ yùdìng le yī jiān [X] de fángjiān, wǒ de míngzi shì [...]) (I booked an [X] room under the name...).

- Room types: 单人间 (dānrénjiān), 双人间 (shuāngrénjiān) (double, 2 separate beds), 大床房 (dàchuángfáng).

Documents: 护照 (hùzhào), 押金 (yājīn) — in China you often leave a 200-500 RMB deposit in cash or on card.

- Service: 打扫 (dǎsǎo), 退房 (tuìfáng), before noon usually.

A problem? 空调坏了 (kōngtiáo huài le), 没有热水 (méiyǒu rèshuǐ), 请换一间 (qǐng huàn yī jiān).
objectivesEn: Say 入住 / 退房
Choose 单人间/双人间/大床房
Understand 押金 (cash deposit)
Report a problem: ...坏了

cecr-b11-travel-m3.introContentEn:
The classics:

(1) 长城 (Chángchéng) — the 八达岭 (Bādálǐng) and 慕田峪 (Mùtiányù) sections.
(2) 故宫 (Gùgōng) in Beijing — book online with your passport, at least 1 day ahead.
(3) 兵马俑 (Bīngmǎyǒng) (Terracotta Army) in Xi'an — an impressive museum.
(4) 外滩 (Wàitān) + 东方明珠 (Dōngfāng Míngzhū) in Shanghai.
(5) 黄山 (Huángshān) for nature.

Tourist vocabulary: 门票 (ménpiào), 开放时间 (kāifàng shíjiān), 导游 (dǎoyóu), 讲解器 (jiǎngjiěqì), 拍照 (pāizhào), 纪念品 (jìniànpǐn). You often need your passport to buy tickets.

- Avoid weekends and public holidays: 人山人海 (rénshān-rénhǎi) (packed crowds).
objectivesEn: Name 5 iconic sites
Book a 门票 with 护照
Hire a 导游 / 讲解器
Avoid the 人山人海

cecr-b11-emo-m1.introTitleEn: 心: the radical that carries emotions
cecr-b11-emo-m1.introContentEn:
In Chinese, most emotions carry the radical 忄 or 心 (xīn).

- 高兴 (gāoxìng), 快乐 (kuàilè), 幸福 (xìngfú).
- 难过 (nánguò), 伤心 (shāngxīn), 生气 (shēngqì), 害怕 (hàipà), 担心 (dānxīn), 紧张 (jǐnzhāng), 失望 (shīwàng).
- Structure: S + 感到 (gǎndào)/觉得 (juéde) + emotion.
- 我感到很高兴 (wǒ gǎndào hěn gāoxìng).

To intensify: 特别 (tèbié), 非常 (fēicháng), 有点儿 (yǒudiǎnr), 比较 (bǐjiào). Cultural rule: modern Chinese people express strong emotions less directly. An 'I love you' may be replaced by 我很在乎你 (wǒ hěn zàihu nǐ). Negative emotions are often softened: 有点不高兴 (yǒudiǎn bù gāoxìng) = actually quite upset.
objectivesEn: Spot the radical 忄/心
Name 10 positive/negative emotions
Use 感到/觉得 + emotion
Soften with 有点 / intensify with 非常

cecr-b11-emo-m2.introTitleEn: 3 ways to say 'I think' by register
cecr-b11-emo-m2.introContentEn:
Three main ways to give your opinion, from most informal to most formal.

(1) 我觉得 (wǒ juéde): everyday, feeling. 我觉得这部电影很好看 (wǒ juéde zhè bù diànyǐng hěn hǎokàn) (I think this movie is good).
(2) 我认为 (wǒ rènwéi): more measured, argumentative. 我认为教育很重要 (wǒ rènwéi jiàoyù hěn zhòngyào) (I believe education is important).
(3) 在我看来 (zài wǒ kànlái) (literally 'in my view'): formal, almost essay-like. 在我看来，这个政策有问题 (zài wǒ kànlái, zhège zhèngcè yǒu wèntí).

- Express doubt: 可能 (kěnéng), 也许 (yěxǔ), 好像 (hǎoxiàng).
- Qualify: 一方面 (yī fāngmiàn)..., 另一方面 (lìng yī fāngmiàn) (on one hand... on the other).
- Agreement: 你说得对 (nǐ shuō de duì), 我同意 (wǒ tóngyì).
- Polite disagreement: 我不太同意 (wǒ bù tài tóngyì) (I don't quite agree).
objectivesEn: Choose 觉得 / 认为 / 在我看来
Qualify with 可能 / 也许
Agree: 你说得对
Soften a disagreement: 不太同意

cecr-b11-emo-m3.introTitleEn: 哪里哪里: gracefully deflecting a compliment
cecr-b11-emo-m3.introContentEn:
In China, taking a compliment with 'thank you!' can seem arrogant. The traditional reply is a polite denial:

- 哪里哪里 (nǎlǐ nǎlǐ) ('no no, not at all').
- 过奖了 (guòjiǎng le) ('you flatter me too much').
- 没有没有 (méiyǒu méiyǒu) ('not at all').

Example: A: 你的中文真好 (nǐ de Zhōngwén zhēn hǎo)! → B: 哪里哪里，还差得远呢 (nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, hái chà de yuǎn ne) (oh no, I still have a long way to go).

To compliment: 你真聪明 (nǐ zhēn cōngmíng), 你做得真好 (nǐ zuò de zhēn hǎo), 你的 [X] 真漂亮 (nǐ de [X] zhēn piàoliang). The compliment should be specific: 'you're kind' stays vague, better 'you're really thoughtful'. This culture is evolving: younger generations increasingly accept a direct 谢谢 (xièxie), but 哪里 (nǎlǐ) remains the safe reply in a formal context.
objectivesEn: Reply to a compliment with 哪里
Give a specific compliment
Use 过奖了 / 没有没有
Navigate between modesty and 谢谢

cecr-b11-health-m1.introContentEn:
Head and upper body: 头 (tóu), 脸 (liǎn), 眼睛 (yǎnjing), 耳朵 (ěrduo), 鼻子 (bízi), 嘴 (zuǐ), 牙 (yá).

- Torso: 脖子 (bózi), 肩膀 (jiānbǎng), 胸 (xiōng), 肚子 (dùzi), 背 (bèi).
- Limbs: 手 (shǒu), 手指 (shǒuzhǐ), 胳膊 (gēbo), 腿 (tuǐ), 脚 (jiǎo).
- Internal organs: 心 (xīn) (heart), 肺 (fèi), 胃 (wèi), 肝 (gān).
- Recurring character: 肉 (ròu) → 肚 (dù) 肺 (fèi) 肝 (gān) 胃 (wèi) (all have the 'flesh' radical).
- Typical expression: [part] 疼 (téng) = to be in pain.
- 我头疼 (wǒ tóu téng).
- 我肚子疼 (wǒ dùzi téng).

Just add 疼 (téng) to the relevant part.
objectivesEn: Name 20 body parts
Spot the radical 肉 / 月
Say ... 疼 for any pain
Locate a pain

cecr-b11-health-m2.introTitleEn: At a Chinese hospital: the journey step by step
cecr-b11-health-m2.introContentEn:
In China, to see a doctor you must 挂号 (guàhào). At the hospital, head to the 挂号处 (guàhàochù) (registration desk), pay the basic fee, get a ticket and go to the relevant department.

- Specialties: 内科 (nèikē), 外科 (wàikē), 儿科 (érkē), 妇科 (fùkē), 牙科 (yákē).
- Standard symptoms: 发烧 (fāshāo), 咳嗽 (késou), 感冒 (gǎnmào), 拉肚子 (lā dùzi), 头疼 (tóuténg), 嗓子疼 (sǎngzi téng).
- Describe: 我觉得 (wǒ juéde)... (I feel...), 我有点 (wǒ yǒudiǎn)... (I'm a bit...).
- Intensity: 有点疼 (yǒudiǎn téng) < 很疼 (hěn téng) < 非常疼 (fēicháng téng).

The doctor prescribes: 开药 (kāiyào), and you go to the hospital's 药房 (yàofáng).
objectivesEn: Do your 挂号 and go to the department
Choose between 内/外/儿/妇科
Describe a symptom with 我觉得
Grade the pain

cecr-b11-health-m3.introTitleEn: The pharmacy in China: key words
cecr-b11-health-m3.introContentEn:
The pharmacy (药店, yàodiàn) is often the first resort in China, even without a prescription.

- Forms: 药片 (yàopiàn), 胶囊 (jiāonáng), 药水 (yàoshuǐ), 药膏 (yàogāo), 眼药水 (yǎnyàoshuǐ).

Common medicines: 感冒药 (gǎnmàoyào), 退烧药 (tuìshāoyào), 止痛药 (zhǐtòngyào), 消炎药 (xiāoyányào), 抗生素 (kàngshēngsù).

- Dosage: 一天三次，每次两片 (yī tiān sān cì, měi cì liǎng piàn) (3 times a day, 2 tablets each time).
- Box labels: 饭前 (fàn qián), 饭后 (fàn hòu), 睡前 (shuì qián).

Traditional Chinese medicine (zhōngyī): 中药 (zhōngyào), 针灸 (zhēnjiǔ), 拔罐 (báguàn), 按摩 (ànmó). Chinese people often combine 西医 (xīyī) and 中医 (zhōngyī).
objectivesEn: Name 5 forms of medicine
Choose between 感冒药/退烧药/止痛药
Read a dosage: 一天三次
Know 针灸, 拔罐, 中药

cecr-b11-conversation-m1.introContentEn:
Giving an opinion or expressing regret in Chinese needs a few key formulas suited to the context.

- Introduce: 在我看来 (zài wǒ kànlái) / 我个人认为 (wǒ gèrén rènwéi) / 从我的角度 (cóng wǒ de jiǎodù).
- Acknowledge: 我理解你的意思，但是… (wǒ lǐjiě nǐ de yìsi, dànshì…) / 你说得有道理，不过… (nǐ shuō de yǒu dàolǐ, búguò…).
- Preference: 我更喜欢 (wǒ gèng xǐhuan) / 比起 X，我更喜欢 Y (bǐ qǐ X, wǒ gèng xǐhuan Y) / 我宁愿 X 也不 Y (wǒ nìngyuàn X yě bù Y).
- Regret: 我后悔了 (wǒ hòuhuǐ le) / 早知道就… (zǎo zhīdào jiù…) / 要是…就好了 (yàoshì…jiù hǎo le) (the magic hypothetical-regret formula).
- Support: 别后悔 (bié hòuhuǐ), 没关系，过去了 (méi guānxi, guòqù le).

Diplomacy: ALWAYS start with 我理解你 (wǒ lǐjiě nǐ) before qualifying — without this preface, your disagreement sounds aggressive in Chinese.
objectivesEn: Argue with 在我看来 / 我个人认为
Prefer with 我更/宁愿 + 也不
Regret with 要是…就好了 / 早知道
Preface a disagreement with 我理解你

cecr-b11-conversation-m2.introContentEn:
Telling an anecdote in Chinese relies on well-chosen time markers and exclamation formulas.

- Markers: 那时候 (nà shíhou), 当时 (dāngshí), 后来 (hòulái), 接着 (jiēzhe), 突然 (tūrán), 最后 (zuìhòu).
- Aspect: 了 (le) vs 过 (guò).
- Arc: initial situation + trigger 突然 (tūrán) + development 然后 (ránhòu) + resolution 最后 (zuìhòu).
- Coloring: 谁知道 (shéi zhīdào), 没想到 (méi xiǎngdào).

Funny/embarrassing anecdote: 我跟你说一件好玩的事 (wǒ gēn nǐ shuō yī jiàn hǎowán de shì) / 太搞笑了 (tài gǎoxiào le) / 笑死我了 (xiào sǐ wǒ le) / 太尴尬了 (tài gāngà le) / 我真想找个地缝钻进去 (wǒ zhēn xiǎng zhǎo gè dìfèng zuān jìnqù). On WeChat, 哈哈哈 (hāhāhā) (3+ 哈) shows engagement; a single 哈 (hā) sounds sarcastic.
objectivesEn: Mark time: 当时 / 后来 / 突然 / 最后
Tell apart 了 (completed) vs 过 (experience)
Color with 谁知道 / 没想到
React with 哈哈哈 (3+ 哈)

cecr-b11-conversation-m3.introContentEn:
In Chinese, expressing disagreement or flagging a hiccup follows precise cultural codes.

- For: 我同意 (wǒ tóngyì) / 完全同意 (wánquán tóngyì) / 我也是这么想的 (wǒ yě shì zhème xiǎng de).
- Against politely: 我不太同意 (wǒ bù tài tóngyì) / 我看法不一样 (wǒ kànfǎ bù yíyàng) / 我觉得不一定 (wǒ juéde bù yídìng).
- Argument: 因为 (yīnwèi) / 由于 (yóuyú) / 比如 (bǐrú) / 据我所知 (jù wǒ suǒ zhī).
- Concession: 你说得对，不过… (nǐ shuō de duì, búguò…).

The 'sandwich' is required in Chinese culture (without the first slice, it sounds aggressive).

- Hiccup: 不好意思，我可能要迟到 (bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ kěnéng yào chídào) / 突然有事，我去不了 (tūrán yǒu shì, wǒ qù bù le).
- Cause + fix: 因为堵车，我会晚 30 分钟 (yīnwèi dǔchē, wǒ huì wǎn 30 fēnzhōng).
- Always close with 真的不好意思 (zhēn de bù hǎoyìsi) / 给你添麻烦了 (gěi nǐ tiān máfan le).
objectivesEn: Debate sandwich: acknowledge + qualify
Announce a delay: cause + fix
Reschedule: 能不能改个时间
Close with 给你添麻烦了

cecr-b11-conversation-m4.introContentEn:
Congratulating and making wishes in Chinese requires knowing a few ritual formulas.

- Specific: 你的中文进步真快 (nǐ de Zhōngwén jìnbù zhēn kuài) / 你这个想法很有创意 (nǐ zhège xiǎngfǎ hěn yǒu chuàngyì) / 你做得太到位了 (nǐ zuò de tài dàowèi le).
- Congratulating success: 恭喜 (gōngxǐ)! / 祝贺你 (zhùhè nǐ)! / 太替你高兴了 (tài tì nǐ gāoxìng le).
- Classic combo: 恭喜恭喜！你太厉害了！ (gōngxǐ gōngxǐ! nǐ tài lìhai le!) (doubling is expected).
- Modern acceptance: 谢谢，你过奖了 (xièxie, nǐ guòjiǎng le) or 谢谢，我会继续努力 (xièxie, wǒ huì jìxù nǔlì).
- Wishes: 生日快乐 (shēngrì kuàilè), 新年快乐 (xīnnián kuàilè), 节日快乐 (jiérì kuàilè), 学业进步 (xuéyè jìnbù), 考试顺利 (kǎoshì shùnlì), 一路平安 (yílù píng'ān), 早日康复 (zǎorì kāngfù).
- For weddings: 百年好合 (bǎinián hǎohé) / 早生贵子 (zǎoshēng guìzǐ).
- For Chinese New Year: 新年快乐！恭喜发财！ (xīnnián kuàilè! gōngxǐ fācái!) (a double wish is expected, especially to elders).
objectivesEn: Compliment PRECISELY (not generic)
Double 恭喜恭喜 + compliment
New Year wish: 新年快乐 + 恭喜发财
Accept with gratitude + humility

cecr-b11-conversation-m5.introTitleEn: Setting up a meeting and introducing yourself
cecr-b11-conversation-m5.introContentEn:
Making an appointment and introducing yourself in an interview needs a formal register and precise formulas.

- Professional appointment: 您好，我想跟您约个时间 (nín hǎo, wǒ xiǎng gēn nín yuē gè shíjiān) / 关于 X 的事情 (guānyú X de shìqing) / 大概需要 30 分钟 (dàgài xūyào 30 fēnzhōng).
- Propose: 您下周二上午方便吗 (nín xià zhōu èr shàngwǔ fāngbiàn ma)? Confirm: 那就这样定了 (nà jiù zhèyàng dìng le).
- Reconfirm 24h before: 明天我们的会议还按计划进行吗 (míngtiān wǒmen de huìyì hái àn jìhuà jìnxíng ma)? (culturally expected).
- Interview: 我叫 X，今年 X 岁，毕业于 X 大学，主修 X (wǒ jiào X, jīnnián X suì, bìyè yú X dàxué, zhǔxiū X).
- Experience: 我有 X 年工作经验 (wǒ yǒu X nián gōngzuò jīngyàn) / 我擅长 X (wǒ shàncháng X) / 我对 X 感兴趣 (wǒ duì X gǎn xìngqù).
- Close: 希望有机会跟您合作 (xīwàng yǒu jīhuì gēn nín hézuò).

Frequent question: '你为什么想来我们公司 (nǐ wèi shénme xiǎng lái wǒmen gōngsī)?' → answer with a specific reason + 我了解贵公司的项目 (wǒ liǎojiě guì gōngsī de xiàngmù). Use 贵公司 (guì gōngsī).
objectivesEn: Arrange formally: 我想跟您约个时间
Reconfirm a pro appointment 24 h before
Introduce yourself: 毕业于 X 大学 + 擅长 X
Use 贵公司 (respected company)

cecr-b11-conversation-m6.introTitleEn: Suggesting without imposing + complaining without offending
cecr-b11-conversation-m6.introContentEn:
INDIRECT advice (Chinese culture respects autonomy): 我跟你说一下我的想法，你参考一下 (wǒ gēn nǐ shuō yíxià wǒ de xiǎngfǎ, nǐ cānkǎo yíxià) / 也许你可以… (yěxǔ nǐ kěyǐ…) / 我建议你… (wǒ jiànyì nǐ…) / 不如…吧 (bùrú…ba).

- Soften: 这只是我的建议 (zhè zhǐshì wǒ de jiànyì) / 你自己决定 (nǐ zìjǐ juédìng).
- AVOID: 你应该 (nǐ yīnggāi), 你必须 (nǐ bìxū).
- Calm complaint: 不好意思，这个菜有点问题 (bù hǎoyìsi, zhège cài yǒudiǎn wèntí) / 我点的不是这个 (wǒ diǎn de bùshì zhège) / 能不能换一下 (néng bù néng huàn yíxià)?
- For a defective product: 这个东西坏了 (zhège dōngxi huài le) / 能退货吗 (néng tuìhuò ma)?

ALWAYS 不好意思 (bù hǎoyìsi) or 麻烦你 (máfan nǐ) first — it softens things massively. Magic sentence: '不好意思，能不能帮我解决一下 (bù hǎoyìsi, néng bù néng bāng wǒ jiějué yíxià)?' — you ask for HELP rather than complaining.
objectivesEn: Advise with 也许你可以 / 不如…吧
Soften with 你参考一下
Complain with 不好意思 + specifics
Magic sentence: 能不能帮我解决一下?

cecr-b11-conversation-m7.introContentEn:
Presenting a project or your career path in Chinese follows an expected, formal structure.

- Project: context → goal → means → benefits structure.
- Open: 我想介绍一下我们的项目 (wǒ xiǎng jièshào yíxià wǒmen de xiàngmù).
- Context: 大家都知道现在 X 是个问题 (dàjiā dōu zhīdào xiànzài X shì gè wèntí).
- Goal: 我们希望解决 X (wǒmen xīwàng jiějué X).
- Means: 通过 X 和 Y (tōngguò X hé Y) / 主要分三个步骤 (zhǔyào fēn sān gè bùzhòu).
- Benefits: 这样可以 X (zhèyàng kěyǐ X).
- Close: 谢谢大家，欢迎提问 (xièxie dàjiā, huānyíng tíwèn).

The Chinese format is more structured; improvisation is frowned upon.

- Career: 我在大学学了 X 年，毕业后去了 X 公司 (wǒ zài dàxué xué le X nián, bìyè hòu qù le X gōngsī).
- Verbs: 学 (xué), 毕业 (bìyè), 工作 (gōngzuò), 换工作 (huàn gōngzuò), 跳槽 (tiàocáo) (HR slang = quit for something better), 创业 (chuàngyè).
- Modern phrase: 我想找一份有意义的工作 (wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn yǒuyìyì de gōngzuò) (a topical concern among young people).
objectivesEn: Present in 4 steps: context → benefits
Avoid improvisation, structure it
Recognize 跳槽 (HR slang)
Understand 有意义的工作 (young people's concern)

cecr-b11-nuances-m1.introTitleEn: 让/使/叫: three ways to make someone do
cecr-b11-nuances-m1.introContentEn:
让 (ràng) = to let / make someone do (spoken, neutral, the most universal).

- 妈妈让我去 (māma ràng wǒ qù) = mom makes me go.

使 (shǐ) = to cause (formal, written, abstract — emotions, states).

- 这个故事使我感动 (zhège gùshi shǐ wǒ gǎndòng) = this story moves me.

NEVER 让我感动 (ràng wǒ gǎndòng) in polished writing. 叫 (jiào) = to order (spoken, authoritative — superior to subordinate).

- 老板叫我加班 (lǎobǎn jiào wǒ jiābān) = the boss ordered me to work overtime.
- Hierarchy: 让 (ràng) < 叫 (jiào) < 使 (shǐ) (formal/abstract).

让 (ràng) ALSO serves as a spoken passive: 我让他骗了 (wǒ ràng tā piàn le) = I got fooled (a spoken variant of 被).

- Even more colloquial: 给 (gěi).
objectivesEn: Choose 让 (neutral) / 叫 (authority) / 使 (formal)
Reserve 使 for abstract emotions/states
Recognize 让 / 给 as a spoken passive
Prefer 被 in B1+ writing

cecr-b11-nuances-m2.introTitleEn: 给/为/替/代: four prepositions, one trap
cecr-b11-nuances-m2.introContentEn:
给 (gěi), 为 (wèi) and 替 (tì)/代 (dài) all express 'for' or 'to' but mark very different relations.

- 给 (gěi) = to, give to (concrete RECIPIENT).
- 我给妈妈打电话 (wǒ gěi māma dǎ diànhuà).
- 为 (wèi) = for, on behalf of (CAUSE / abstract motivation): 我为你高兴 (wǒ wèi nǐ gāoxìng) / 我为环境做点事 (wǒ wèi huánjìng zuò diǎn shì).
- 替 (tì) = in place of (physical SUBSTITUTION, spoken): 我替你去 (wǒ tì nǐ qù).
- 代 (dài) = to replace (FORMAL, institutional): 代表 (dàibiǎo) / 代理 (dàilǐ) / 代课 (dàikè).
- Classic mistake: 我为妈妈打电话 (wǒ wèi māma dǎ diànhuà) ✗ → use 给 (gěi).

In writing, prefer 代 (dài); in speech between friends, 替 (tì).

- Very useful formula: '代我向 X 问好 (dài wǒ xiàng X wènhǎo)' = give my regards to X.
objectivesEn: Choose 给 (recipient) vs 为 (motivation)
Tell apart 替 (spoken) vs 代 (formal)
Build 代我向 X 问好
Feel the emotional difference 为 vs 替

cecr-b11-nuances-m3.introTitleEn: 起来/下去/出来: begin, continue, reveal
cecr-b11-nuances-m3.introContentEn:
Three directional compounds used aspectually — they express aspect, not physical direction.

- **起来** (qǐlái) = to **START** to / to seem: 我笑起来了 (wǒ xiào qǐlái le), 看起来 (kàn qǐlái).
- **下去** (xiàqù) = to **CONTINUE**: 看下去 (kàn xiàqù) = keep reading.
- **出来** (chūlái) = to **REVEAL**: 听出来 (tīng chūlái) = to make out by ear.

**Sense verb + 起来 = sensory impression:**

- 看起来 (kàn qǐlái), 听起来 (tīng qǐlái), 闻起来 (wén qǐlái), 吃起来 (chī qǐlái).
- 这个菜看起来很好吃 (zhège cài kàn qǐlái hěn hǎochī).

**Classic pitfall:** using 像 (xiàng) instead of 看起来 (kàn qǐlái) — 像 compares (it looks like), 看起来 expresses an impression.

**All-purpose formula:** 看起来不错 (kàn qǐlái búcuò)，但我没尝过 (dàn wǒ méi cháng guò).
objectivesEn: Memorize 起来 (start) / 下去 (continue) / 出来 (reveal)
Build 看起来 / 听起来 / 闻起来
Tell apart 像 (comparison) vs 看起来 (impression)
All-purpose sentence: 看起来不错

cecr-b11-nuances-m4.introTitleEn: 像/好像/似乎: to resemble or to seem?
cecr-b11-nuances-m4.introContentEn:
三个词，三个层次 — three levels to express resemblance and impression.

- **像** (xiàng) = to **resemble** (concrete, physical): 他像他爸爸 (tā xiàng tā bàba).
- **好像** (hǎoxiàng) = it seems / looks like (an uncertain impression, **spoken**): 好像下雨了 (hǎoxiàng xià yǔ le).
- **似乎** (sìhū) = to seem (**formal**, written): 似乎不太可能 (sìhū bù tài kěnéng).

**Classic pitfall:** using 像 (xiàng) for 'it seems that' — prefer 好像 (hǎoxiàng) in speech.

In spoken B1, 好像 (hǎoxiàng) is your no.1 tool to soften a statement.

**Equal comparison:** 跟 (gēn) X **一样** (yíyàng) + adj = as… as X.

- 他跟我一样高 (tā gēn wǒ yíyàng gāo) = he's as tall as me.
- **似的** (shìde) at the end of a sentence marks a figurative comparison: 他叫得像狼嚎似的 (tā jiào de xiàng láng háo shìde).
objectivesEn: Choose 像 (concrete) vs 好像 (impression)
Reserve 似乎 for writing
Build 跟 X 一样 + adjective
Soften with 好像 in speech

cecr-b11-nuances-m5.introTitleEn: 拿/带/抱/送/寄/递: the right verb for the situation
cecr-b11-nuances-m5.introContentEn:
拿 (ná) = to take / carry in the HAND.

- 我拿着一本书 (wǒ ná zhe yī běn shū).

带 (dài) = to BRING along (object OR person, movement).

- 我带了水 (wǒ dài le shuǐ) / 我带孩子去公园 (wǒ dài háizi qù gōngyuán).

抱 (bào) = to carry in the ARMS / hug.

- 抱孩子 (bào háizi) / 抱你一下 (bào nǐ yíxià).

送 (sòng) = to GIVE (a gift) / accompany / deliver.

- 我送你一个礼物 (wǒ sòng nǐ yī gè lǐwù) / 我送你回家 (wǒ sòng nǐ huí jiā) (= I'll walk you home — the strong Chinese sense of 'giving your time').

寄 (jì) = to send by POST/mail.

- 我寄了一封信 (wǒ jì le yī fēng xìn) / 寄快递 (jì kuàidì).

递 (dì) = to pass HAND-TO-HAND.

- 把那个递给我 (bǎ nàge dì gěi wǒ).
objectivesEn: Tell apart 拿 (hand) / 带 (bring) / 抱 (arms)
Tell apart 送 (give/accompany) / 寄 (post) / 递 (hand)
Understand 送 = giving your time
Choose the verb by channel/weight

cecr-b11-nuances-m6.introTitleEn: 听/听见/听到 and 感觉/觉得: essential nuances
cecr-b11-nuances-m6.introContentEn:
Two trios to tell apart: action vs result, sensation vs opinion.

**听 (tīng) / 听见 (tīngjiàn) / 听到 (tīngdào):**

- **听** = to listen (a voluntary action).
- **听见** = to have heard (accomplished perception, without effort).
- **听到** = to have received info: 我听到他生病了 (wǒ tīngdào tā shēngbìng le) = I heard he's sick.
- **听懂** = to understand what you hear: 我没听懂 (wǒ méi tīng dǒng).

In speech, 听见 and 听到 are often interchangeable, except for rumors/info (→ 听到).

**感觉 (gǎnjué) / 觉得 (juéde) / 感到 (gǎndào):**

- **感觉** = a physical or emotional sensation: 我感觉很累 (wǒ gǎnjué hěn lèi).
- **觉得** = a subjective opinion: 我觉得这本书很好 (wǒ juéde zhè běn shū hěn hǎo).
- **感到** = to feel (**formal/written**): 感到惊讶 (gǎndào jīngyà).

**Practical rule:** in speech, choose 感觉 (body) or 觉得 (opinion). In writing, 感到.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 听 (action) / 听见 (result) / 听到 (info)
Choose 听见 / 听到 / 听懂
Tell apart 感觉 (sensation) vs 觉得 (opinion)
Reserve 感到 for writing

cecr-b11-nuances-m7.introTitleEn: 一边…一边 vs 又…又: to act or to be?
cecr-b11-nuances-m7.introContentEn:
Two structures of simultaneity — but they are not interchangeable.

- **一边 X 一边 Y** = do X and Y **at the same time** (two **actions**): 我一边吃饭一边看电视 (wǒ yìbiān chī fàn yìbiān kàn diànshì).
- **又 X 又 Y** = to have X and Y simultaneously (two **qualities/states**): 这个菜又好吃又便宜 (zhège cài yòu hǎochī yòu piányi).

**Classic pitfall:** 我又吃饭又看电视 (wǒ yòu chī fàn yòu kàn diànshì) ✗ — 又…又… isn't used with two concurrent actions. You need 一边…一边….

**For 'moreover', adding an idea:**

- **还** (hái) < **而且** (érqiě) < **并且** (bìngqiě) < **此外** (cǐwài) — increasing register.
- In spoken B1, 而且 (érqiě) is the default. 并且 sounds written.
objectivesEn: Build 一边 X 一边 Y (concurrent actions)
Build 又 X 又 Y (coexisting qualities)
Choose 而且 (spoken) vs 并且 (written)
Rank 还 → 而且 → 并且 → 此外

cecr-b12-bu-m1.introTitleEn: 不: negating habit, will, the future
cecr-b12-bu-m1.introContentEn:
不 (bù) goes **before** verbs and adjectives to negate a habit, a will or a quality.

- Habit: 我不吃肉 (wǒ bù chī ròu) = I don't eat meat (in general).
- Will: 我不去 (wǒ bù qù) = I don't want to / won't go.
- Quality: 她不漂亮 (tā bù piàoliang).
- Future: 明天我不来 (míngtiān wǒ bù lái) = I won't come tomorrow.

**Tone rule:** 不 (tone 4) + a tone-4 word → 不 becomes **tone 2**.

- 不是 → bú shì, 不要 → bú yào.

**Modals:** 不 (bù) is always the negation of modals.

- 不能 (bù néng), 不会 (bù huì), 不可以 (bù kěyǐ), 不想 (bù xiǎng).

**Pitfall:** never use 没 (méi) with modals.
objectivesEn: Use 不 for habit and will
Apply the sandhi 不 (tone 2 before tone 4)
Negate the future with 不
Use 不能/不会/不想

cecr-b12-mei-m1.introTitleEn: 没: negating the completed and possession
cecr-b12-mei-m1.introContentEn:
没 (méi) — and its long form 没有 (méiyǒu) — negates an **objective fact**: something didn't happen or doesn't exist.

- Possession: 我没有钱 (wǒ méiyǒu qián) = I have no money.
- Completed but not realized: 我没吃饭 (wǒ méi chī fàn) = I haven't eaten.
- Absent experience: 我没去过中国 (wǒ méi qù guò Zhōngguó) = I've never been to China.

**Absolute rule:** 没 (méi) = objective fact; **不 (bù)** = subjective refusal.

- 我不吃饭 = I don't eat (habit/choice).
- 我没吃饭 = I haven't eaten (this time).

**Pitfalls:**

- 没 + 了 = **FORBIDDEN**: 我没吃了 ✗.
- State verbs (是, 认识, 知道) → always 不, never 没.
objectivesEn: Use 没 for the unrealized completed
Use 没有 for possession
Avoid 没...了 (forbidden double negation)
Tell apart 我不吃 / 我没吃

cecr-b12-bumei-m1.introTitleEn: 不 vs 没: the 3-question decision tree
cecr-b12-bumei-m1.introContentEn:
Facing a sentence to negate, ask yourself 3 questions:

- Habit / taste / will / future? → **不** (bù).
- Action that should have happened but didn't? → **没** (méi).
- Possession / existence? → **没有** (méiyǒu).

**Classic tricky case:** 'I don't eat meat'

- 我不吃肉 (wǒ bù chī ròu) = I'm vegetarian, it's my choice.
- 我没吃肉 (wǒ méi chī ròu) = this time I didn't eat any — but usually I do.

**Another pitfall:** 知道 (zhīdào), 认识 (rènshi), 是 (shì), 喜欢 (xǐhuan) are **continuous state verbs** → always 不, never 没.

- 我不知道 ✓, 我没知道 ✗.

**Safety rule:** all state verbs are negated with **不**.
objectivesEn: Apply the 不/没 decision tree
Correct 10 tricky sentences
Ban 没 + state verbs
Master 我不吃肉 vs 我没吃肉

cecr-b12-hui-m1.introTitleEn: 会: acquired skill or future probability
cecr-b12-hui-m1.introContentEn:
会 (huì) has two distinct uses — skill and probability.

**1. Learned skill:**

- 我会开车 (wǒ huì kāichē), 他会说中文 (tā huì shuō Zhōngwén), 她会游泳 (tā huì yóuyǒng).
- The skill has been **learned** — even if you can't use it right now.

**2. Probability / future:**

- 明天会下雨 (míngtiān huì xià yǔ) = it will probably rain.
- 他会来的 (tā huì lái de) = he'll surely come. The final **的 (de)** reinforces the certainty.

**Negation:** 不会 (bù huì) = doesn't know how / won't.

- 我不会说日语 (wǒ bù huì shuō rìyǔ), 不会下雨 (bù huì xià yǔ).

**Key distinction with 能:** if the action requires learning (a language, driving, drawing) → **会** (huì).
objectivesEn: Use 会 for a learned skill
Use 会 for a probability
Reinforce with final 的
Tell apart 会 (learned) from 能 (able)

cecr-b12-neng-m1.introTitleEn: 能: present ability and informal permission
cecr-b12-neng-m1.introContentEn:
能 (néng) is about **present ability**: you have the skill AND the conditions are met.

- 我会游泳 (wǒ huì yóuyǒng), 但今天我感冒了，不能游 (bù néng yóu). The skill remains, but 能 is blocked by circumstances.

**Other uses:**

- Quantity: 他能吃三碗饭 (tā néng chī sān wǎn fàn) = he can eat 3 bowls.
- Possibility: 这个办法能解决问题 (zhège bànfǎ néng jiějué wèntí) = this method can solve the problem.
- Informal permission: 我能进来吗 (wǒ néng jìnlái ma)? — a flexible equivalent of 可以 (kěyǐ).

**Negation:** 不能 (bù néng).

**会 vs 能:** 会 = learned skill; 能 = actual ability in the present situation.
objectivesEn: Use 能 for conditioned ability
Express a quantity with 能
Ask informal permission with 能
Tell apart 会 / 能

cecr-b12-keyi-m1.introContentEn:
可以 (kěyǐ) expresses **permission** (rule, right) or **acceptability** (it's OK).

- Permission: 你可以走了 (nǐ kěyǐ zǒu le) = you may go (it's allowed).
- Regulation: 这里可以抽烟吗 (zhèlǐ kěyǐ chōu yān ma)? = can you smoke here?
- Suggestion: 我们可以试试 (wǒmen kěyǐ shì shì) = we could try.
- 'It's OK': 我觉得这个方案可以 (wǒ juéde zhège fāng'àn kěyǐ) = I think this solution is acceptable.

**Key distinction:**

- 我不能游泳 = I **can't** swim (body/conditions).
- 这儿不可以游泳 = swimming is **forbidden** here (regulation).

**Negation:** 不可以 (bù kěyǐ) is strong, almost 'forbidden'. 不能 (bù néng) is more neutral.
objectivesEn: Use 可以 for permission
Use 可以 for a suggestion
Say 不可以 = forbidden
Choose between 能 / 可以

cecr-b12-modal-m1.introTitleEn: 会/能/可以: the test in 3 scenarios
cecr-b12-modal-m1.introContentEn:
Swimming perfectly illustrates the three modals — same situation, three different questions.

- **会**: 你会游泳吗 (nǐ huì yóuyǒng ma)? = do you **know how** to swim? (learned skill)
- **能**: 你今天能游泳吗 (nǐ jīntiān néng yóuyǒng ma)? = **can** you swim today? (body + conditions)
- **可以**: 这儿可以游泳吗 (zhèr kěyǐ yóuyǒng ma)? = is it **allowed** to swim here? (regulation)

**Test in 3 scenarios:**

- 'He can speak French' → learned skill → **会**: 他会说法语 (tā huì shuō fǎyǔ).
- 'I can't come tomorrow, I'm sick' → blocked ability → **不能**: 我明天不能来 (wǒ míngtiān bù néng lái).
- 'Can we sit here?' → permission → **可以**: 这儿可以坐吗 (zhèr kěyǐ zuò ma)?

In speech, **能** is the most frequent, then **可以**, then **会**.
objectivesEn: Sort 15 sentences into 会/能/可以
Rephrase the same idea with all 3
Choose the right negation
Know when the 3 are interchangeable

cecr-b12-hai-m1.introContentEn:
还 (hái) has **3 values** — learn them in order of frequency.

**1. Continuation** (still, yet) — placed BEFORE the verb:

- 他还在睡觉 (tā hái zài shuìjiào) = he's still sleeping.
- 我还没吃 (wǒ hái méi chī) = I haven't eaten yet.

**2. Addition** (in addition, also):

- 我喜欢咖啡，还喜欢茶 (wǒ xǐhuan kāfēi, hái xǐhuan chá) = I like coffee, and tea too.
- 还有一支笔 (háiyǒu yī zhī bǐ) = and also a pen.

**3. Moderation** (not bad, fairly) — very frequent in speech:

- 还不错 (hái búcuò) = not bad.
- 还可以 (hái kěyǐ) = it's OK / acceptable.

**Spoken classic:** 还没…呢 (hái méi…ne) = not yet (with a hint of anticipation).
objectivesEn: Use 还 for continuation
Use 还 for addition
Grasp 还不错 / 还可以
Combine 还 + 没...呢

cecr-b12-you-m1.introTitleEn: 又: 'again' for what has already happened
cecr-b12-you-m1.introContentEn:
又 (yòu) means 'again' for an action that **has already happened** (past or habitual).

- 他又迟到了 (tā yòu chídào le) = he's **late again** (implied: reproach).
- 昨天下雨了，今天又下雨了 (jīntiān yòu xià yǔ le) = it rained yesterday, and it's raining again today.

**Typical structure: 又 + V + 了** — the 了 (le) is nearly mandatory.

**又 (past) vs 再 (future):**

- 他又来了 (tā yòu lái le) = he came again (already arrived).
- 明天他再来 (míngtiān tā zài lái) = he'll come again tomorrow (future).

**Pitfall:** 他又来 ✗ without 了 is incorrect. You need either 了 (past) or 再 (future).

**Other use: 又…又…** = both… and… (two qualities): 她又聪明又漂亮 (tā yòu cōngmíng yòu piàoliang).
objectivesEn: Use 又 for a past repetition
Combine 又 + V + 了
Avoid 又 for a future (→ 再)
Use 又...又... for 'both'

cecr-b12-bi-m1.introTitleEn: 比: the comparative, without 很 and with 更
cecr-b12-bi-m1.introContentEn:
比 (bǐ) builds the Chinese comparative — simple structure, classic mistake.

**Basic structure: A + 比 + B + adjective**

- 我比他高 (wǒ bǐ tā gāo) = I'm taller than him.
- 中国比法国大 (Zhōngguó bǐ Fǎguó dà) = China is bigger than France.

**Classic mistake:** 我比他**很**高 ✗ — never 很 after 比.

**Specify the gap:** A + 比 + B + adj + quantity

- 我比他高五厘米 (wǒ bǐ tā gāo wǔ límǐ) = 5 cm taller.
- 他比我大两岁 (tā bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì) = 2 years older.

**Intensify:** A + 比 + B + **更** + adj

- 她比他更聪明 (tā bǐ tā gèng cōngmíng) = even smarter.

**Negation:** A + **没有** + B + adj

- 我没有他高 (wǒ méiyǒu tā gāo) = I'm not as tall as him.
objectivesEn: Form A + 比 + B + adjective (no 很)
Quantify the difference: 高五厘米
Intensify with 更
Negate: A + 没有 + B + adj

cecr-b12-narr-m1.introTitleEn: 12 connectors to tell a story in Chinese
cecr-b12-narr-m1.introContentEn:
12 connectors to memorize for telling any anecdote in Chinese.

**Narrative sequence:**

- 首先 (shǒuxiān) → 然后 (ránhòu) → 后来 (hòulái) → 最后 (zuìhòu)

**Time anchoring:**

- 那时候 (nà shíhou), 当时 (dāngshí), 突然 (tūrán), 正在 (zhèngzài)

**Causality:** **因为…所以** — both sides exist in Chinese, unlike English.

- 因为下雨，所以我没去 (yīnwèi xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒ méi qù).

**Concession:** **虽然…但是** — likewise, both sides.

- 虽然很贵，但是很好 (suīrán hěn guì, dànshì hěn hǎo).

**Closing:** 结果 (jiéguǒ) = finally (often unexpected); 从此 (cóngcǐ) = from then on.
objectivesEn: Chain 首先/然后/后来/最后
Use 突然/当时 for drama
Form 因为...所以 and 虽然...但是
Close with 结果 / 从此

cecr-b12-narr-m2.introTitleEn: The past in Chinese: one date, then all present
cecr-b12-narr-m2.introContentEn: No simple past or imperfect in Chinese. You set the narrative in the past with: (1) an explicit date: 去年夏天 (qùnián xiàtiān), 十年前 (shí nián qián) (10 years ago), 那一天 (nà yī tiān). (2) Once the date is set, all verbs stay in the present! 去年我去了中国，每天都吃面条 (qùnián wǒ qù le Zhōngguó, měi tiān dōu chī miàntiáo) (last year I went to China, I ate noodles every day) — notice: 了 (le) only on 去 (qù), not on 吃 (chī). (3) For the imperfect (simultaneous ongoing actions), use 在 (zài)/正在 (zhèngzài): 那时候我正在工作 (nà shíhou wǒ zhèngzài gōngzuò) (at that moment, I was working). This principle is liberating: no conjugation, just good use of time markers and the aspects 了 (le)/过 (guò)/在 (zài).
objectivesEn: Set a time frame at the start
Conjugate NOTHING — all present
Place 了 only on unique actions
Use 在/正在 for the imperfect

cecr-b12-narr-m3.introTitleEn: Reported speech: 说/告诉/问 without tense agreement
cecr-b12-narr-m3.introContentEn:
In Chinese, you report simply with 说 (shuō): 他说他明天来 (tā shuō tā míngtiān lái) (he says he's coming tomorrow). No sequence of tenses! You keep the original tense. Other verbs: 告诉 (gàosu) (to tell — needs a recipient: 他告诉我...); 问 (wèn); 回答 (huídá); 解释 (jiěshì). For an indirect question, you do NOT use 吗 (ma), but rather 是否 (shìfǒu) or the A-不 (bù)-A alternative: 他问我去不去 (tā wèn wǒ qù bù qù).

- Direct quote: 他说 (tā shuō): '我来 (wǒ lái)'.
- Indirect quote: 他说他来 (tā shuō tā lái).

In modern Chinese, the indirect quote without 'that' (= 'I say he's coming') is the norm — no 说 + 的 or other marker. It's fluid and economical.
objectivesEn: Use 说 without tense agreement
Tell apart 说 / 告诉 / 问
Form an indirect question with A-不-A
Switch direct ↔ indirect

cecr-b12-narr-m4.introContentEn:
A Chinese portrait is built in layers.

(1) General build: 高高的 (gāo gāo de), 瘦瘦的 (shòu shòu de), 胖胖的 (pàng pàng de) — reduplicating the adjective softens it and gives an affectionate feel.
(2) Face: 圆脸 (yuán liǎn), 大眼睛 (dà yǎnjing), 短头发 (duǎn tóufa).
(3) Clothes: 穿着 (chuān zhe) + garment, e.g. 裙子 (qúnzi), she's wearing a red dress — 穿着 (chuān zhe) is the state marker.
(4) Character: 性格 (xìnggé) + adjective.

Frequent character adjectives: 开朗 (kāilǎng), 内向 (nèixiàng), 幽默 (yōumò), 认真 (rènzhēn), 耐心 (nàixīn), 大方 (dàfang), 害羞 (hàixiū).

- For an impression: 看起来 (kàn qǐlái) + adj: 他看起来很聪明 (tā kàn qǐlái hěn cōngmíng).
- Pitfall: don't stack 很 (hěn) before a reduplicated adjective (很高高的 (hěn gāo gāo de) ✗).
objectivesEn: Stack build → clothes → character
Use 穿着 to describe clothing
Choose 开朗 / 内向 / 幽默 / 认真
Form 看起来 + adjective

cecr-b12-narr-m5.introTitleEn: Describing a place: from setting to atmosphere
cecr-b12-narr-m5.introContentEn:
To set a scene:

(1) Frame the space with 在 (zài) + place + 有 (yǒu) + object. 在公园里，有很多老人 (zài gōngyuán lǐ, yǒu hěn duō lǎorén) (in the park, there are many elderly people).
(2) Locate with relative positions: 前面 (qiánmiàn), 后面 (hòumiàn), 左边 (zuǒbian), 右边 (yòubian), 旁边 (pángbiān), 中间 (zhōngjiān). Note: the structure is 名词 (noun) + 的 (de) + position: 桌子的旁边 (zhuōzi de pángbiān) (next to the table).
(3) Describe the atmosphere: 安静 (ānjìng), 热闹 (rènao) (lively, the exact opposite of quiet, very positive in China), 拥挤 (yōngjǐ), 舒服 (shūfu), 气氛很好 (qìfēn hěn hǎo).
(4) Enrich with sounds and smells: 听到 (tīngdào) + sound, 闻到 (wéndào) + smell. 我听到了鸟叫 (wǒ tīngdào le niǎo jiào) (I hear the birds singing), 闻到了花香 (wéndào le huāxiāng) (I smell the flowers).

This 到 (dào) after a perception verb marks that you DID perceive it — an important distinction from a plain 听 (tīng).
objectivesEn: Open with 在 + place + 有 + X
Use 前/后/左/右/旁边/中间
Qualify with 安静 / 热闹 / 拥挤
Make it vivid with 听到 / 闻到

cecr-b12-edu-m1.introTitleEn: The Chinese school system in 5 levels
cecr-b12-edu-m1.introContentEn:
Chinese school system: 幼儿园 (yòu'éryuán) (kindergarten, ages 3-6), 小学 (xiǎoxué) (primary, 6 years), 初中 (chūzhōng) (middle school, 3 years) — the 9 compulsory years. Then 高中 (gāozhōng) (high school, 3 years), crowned by the 高考 (gāokǎo) — one of the world's hardest exams, determining an entire career.

- University: 大学 (dàxué), 本科 (běnkē) (bachelor's, 4 years), 研究生 (yánjiūshēng), 博士 (bóshì).
- University rankings: 一本 (yīběn) (top-tier, 'C9'), 二本 (èrběn), 三本 (sānběn).
- 清华 (Qīnghuá) and 北大 (Běidà) (Tsinghua, Peking University) are the two peaks.

Teaching professions: 老师 (lǎoshī), 教授 (jiàoshòu), 导师 (dǎoshī).
objectivesEn: Name the 5 school stages
Understand the stakes of the 高考
Tell apart 本科 / 研究生 / 博士
Know 清华 and 北大

cecr-b12-edu-m2.introTitleEn: 学 vs 学习: spoken vs formal
cecr-b12-edu-m2.introContentEn:
学 (xué) and 学习 (xuéxí) both mean 'to learn / study', but differ in register.

- 学 (xué): more spoken, often followed by a direct object. 学中文 (xué Zhōngwén), 学开车 (xué kāichē).
- 学习 (xuéxí): more written, more formal, more abstract. 努力学习 (nǔlì xuéxí), 学习经验 (xuéxí jīngyàn) (learn from experience).

Typical phrases: 复习 (fùxí), 预习 (yùxí) (prepare before class), 练习 (liànxí), 做作业 (zuò zuòyè), 背 (bèi) (memorize), 记 (jì). For exams: 考试 (kǎoshì), 考得怎么样 (kǎo de zěnmeyàng)? (how did it go?), 及格 (jígé), 不及格 (bù jígé), 满分 (mǎnfēn) (perfect score).

加油 (jiāyóu)! (good luck!) is THE magic word for Chinese students.
objectivesEn: Choose 学 (spoken) / 学习 (formal)
Tell apart 复习/预习/练习
Use 做作业, 背, 记
Encourage with 加油!

cecr-b12-edu-m3.introContentEn:
Essential vocabulary for talking about your Chinese learning.

- 汉字 (Hànzì), 拼音 (pīnyīn), 声调 (shēngdiào), 笔画 (bǐhuà), 部首 (bùshǒu).
- Four skills: 听 (tīng), 说 (shuō), 读 (dú), 写 (xiě).

Chinese people will always tell you: 你的中文真好 (nǐ de Zhōngwén zhēn hǎo)! (your Chinese is great!) — be modest: 哪里哪里，还差得远 (nǎlǐ nǎlǐ, hái chà de yuǎn). Describing your level: 我学了三年 (wǒ xué le sān nián) (I've studied for 3 years), 我能看懂简单的文章 (wǒ néng kàn dǒng jiǎndān de wénzhāng) (I understand simple texts), 我的发音还不太准 (wǒ de fāyīn hái bù tài zhǔn) (my pronunciation isn't accurate yet). Asking for a rephrase: 请再说一遍 (qǐng zài shuō yī biàn), 慢一点 (màn yīdiǎn), 这个字怎么写 (zhège zì zěnme xiě)? (how do you write this character?).
objectivesEn: Name 汉字/拼音/声调/笔画
Describe your level with 学了...年
Ask 再说一遍 / 慢一点
Handle the compliment with 哪里

cecr-b12-soc-m1.introTitleEn: 外 and 堂/表: paternal vs maternal family
cecr-b12-soc-m1.introContentEn:
Chinese carefully distinguishes paternal and maternal relatives.

- Grandparents: 爷爷 (yéye) ≠ 外公 (wàigōng); 奶奶 (nǎinai) ≠ 外婆 (wàipó).

The 外 (wài) ('outside') marks everything from the mother's side — a reminder of old patriarchy: the daughter 'leaves' for her in-laws' family.

- Uncle/aunt: 叔叔 (shūshu), 伯伯 (bóbo), 姑姑 (gūgu), vs 舅舅 (jiùjiu), 姨妈 (yímā).
- Cousins: 堂 (táng) (father's side), 表 (biǎo) (mother's side): 堂兄 (tángxiōng)/堂弟 (tángdì)/表哥 (biǎogē)/表妹 (biǎomèi).
- Older/younger: always marked.

With the one-child policy, this vocabulary becomes technical but remains necessary to understand society and literature.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 爷爷/外公, 奶奶/外婆
Use 叔叔/伯伯/姑姑/舅舅/姨妈
Understand 堂 (father) vs 表 (mother)
Mark older/younger

cecr-b12-soc-m2.introTitleEn: Marriage in China: steps and vocabulary
cecr-b12-soc-m2.introContentEn:
Marriage in China follows codified steps, with specific vocabulary and social pressures.

- Steps: 谈恋爱 (tán liàn'ài), 订婚 (dìnghūn), 领证 (lǐngzhèng), 婚礼 (hūnlǐ), 度蜜月 (dù mìyuè).
- Separable verb: 结了婚 (jié le hūn); 离婚 (líhūn) = to divorce; 孩子 (háizi) / 子女 (zǐnǚ) = child.

Cultural note: in China, 领证 (lǐngzhèng) is the real official union; the ceremony may take place months later. Social pressure to marry is strong — 剩女 (shèngnǚ) ('leftover women' over 27) and 光棍 (guānggùn) ('bare sticks' = single men) are well-known but contested labels.

Child policy: 一孩政策 (yī hái zhèngcè) (1980-2015), 二孩政策 (èr hái zhèngcè) (2016-21), now 三孩政策 (sān hái zhèngcè) since 2021.
objectivesEn: Use 结婚 as a separable verb
Know 谈恋爱 / 订婚 / 领证 / 婚礼
Understand 领证 / 婚礼 distinction
Know the child policy

cecr-b12-soc-m3.introContentEn:
In China, people talk a lot about generations by their birth decade.

- 80后 (bālínghòu, born in the 80s), 90后 (jiǔlínghòu), 00后 (línglínghòu, born in the 2000s — pronounced 'líng líng hòu').

Each generation has its label: 80后 = first only-child generation, hard workers, buying their first apartments. 90后 = digital natives, often criticized as 'spoiled', in fact more open.

- 00后 = the Chinese Gen Z, TikTok, ultra-connected, more socially liberal.

Recent expressions: 躺平 (tǎng píng) ('lying flat' — refusing endless economic competition), 内卷 (nèijuǎn) ('involution' — absurd competition where no one wins anymore), 打工人 (dǎgōngrén) ('the worker' — self-mockery of 90后/00后). These terms are everywhere in Chinese online.
objectivesEn: Use 80后/90后/00后
Grasp 躺平 and 内卷
Call yourself 打工人 (self-deprecation)
Read a generational debate

cecr-b12-soc-m4.introTitleEn: Finding a job in China: 求职 and 面试
cecr-b12-soc-m4.introContentEn:
The Chinese job market is tight for young graduates (the 16-24 unemployment rate topped 20% in 2023).

- Key vocabulary: 求职 (qiúzhí) (job hunting), 简历 (jiǎnlì), 面试 (miànshì), 录取 (lùqǔ), 工资 (gōngzī), 五险一金 (wǔ xiǎn yī jīn) ('5 insurances + 1 fund', the mandatory social contributions).
- Sectors: 国企 (guóqǐ), 外企 (wàiqǐ), 私企 (sīqǐ), 创业 (chuàngyè).

Useful interview phrases: 我对贵公司很感兴趣 (wǒ duì guì gōngsī hěn gǎn xìngqù) (I'm very interested in your company), 我的优势是... (wǒ de yōushì shì...) (my strength is...), 您希望什么时候入职 (nín xīwàng shénme shíhou rùzhí)? (when would you like me to start?). Trending term: 996 (9am to 9pm, 6 days/7), 007 (24/7) — critiques of overwork.
objectivesEn: Form an oral mini-CV (专业, 经验, 优势)
Use 求职 / 面试 / 录取 / 工资
Compare 国企 / 外企 / 私企 / 创业
Grasp 996 / 007 in the social debate

cecr-b12-med-m1.introContentEn:
新闻 (xīnwén) means the news; understanding media vocabulary is essential to follow information.

- Types: 头条 (tóutiáo), 报道 (bàodào), 评论 (pínglùn), 专访 (zhuānfǎng), 社论 (shèlùn).
- Media: 报纸 (bàozhǐ), 电视 (diànshì), 广播 (guǎngbō), 网站 (wǎngzhàn), 公众号 (gōngzhònghào).
- Journalists: 记者 (jìzhě), 编辑 (biānjí), 主持人 (zhǔchírén).
- Verbs: 报道 (bàodào) = to report; 发布 (fābù) = to publish; 转发 (zhuǎnfā) = to share/forward.

Typical structure of a Chinese article: the who-what-where-when-how (5W) leads the sentence, details after — the same model as the Anglo-Saxon press.

- Example headline: 昨天，北京发生地震 (zuótiān, Běijīng fāshēng dìzhèn) (yesterday, an earthquake in Beijing).
objectivesEn: Name article types (头条/报道/评论)
Tell apart media (报纸/网站/公众号)
Spot 记者 / 编辑 / 主持人
Understand the Chinese 5W structure

cecr-b12-med-m2.introContentEn:
A Chinese headline drops particles (的/了/呢), obvious subjects, and compresses to the max.

- 北京重霾今停课 (Běijīng zhòng mái jīn tíngkè) (Beijing heavy smog, classes suspended today).
- 美国加息人民币跌 (Měiguó jiāxī rénmínbì diē) (US raises rates, yuan falls).

Verbs are in the present, no time marker. Common abbreviations: 央视 (yāngshì) = 中央电视台 (Zhōngyāng Diànshìtái), 北大 (Běidà) = 北京大学, 清华 (Qīnghuá) = 清华大学, 地铁 (dìtiě) = 城市地下铁路, 美联储 (Měiliánchǔ) = the Fed.

- Chinese figures: 万 (wàn) (10,000), 亿 (yì) (100 million).
- 十亿 (shí yì) = 1 billion.
- Common economic topic: GDP = 国内生产总值 (guónèi shēngchǎn zǒngzhí); inflation = 通货膨胀 (tōnghuò péngzhàng) / 通胀 (tōngzhàng).

Politics: 政府 (zhèngfǔ), 政策 (zhèngcè) (policy), 主席 (zhǔxí), 两会 (liǎnghuì) (the Two Sessions — National Congress).
objectivesEn: Decode a compressed headline
Recognize abbreviations (央视, 北大...)
Read large numbers (万, 亿)
Identify an article's topic in 5 sec

cecr-b12-med-m3.introContentEn:
China has its own platforms — Google, Facebook, YouTube, Instagram are blocked.

- Equivalents: 微博 (Wēibó), 抖音 (Dǒuyīn), 小红书 (Xiǎohóngshū), 知乎 (Zhīhū), 哔哩哔哩 (Bìlībìlī) (Bilibili ≈ young YouTube), 百度 (Bǎidù).
- Actions: 关注 (guānzhù), 点赞 (diǎnzàn), 评论 (pínglùn), 转发 (zhuǎnfā), 分享 (fēnxiǎng).
- Figures: 粉丝 (fěnsī), 大V (dà V) (verified influencer, V for 'verified'), 网红 (wǎnghóng), 博主 (bózhǔ).

To cross the firewall: 翻墙 (fānqiáng) ('jump the wall'), a colloquial term for using a VPN. Suggesting a VPN remains legally sensitive.
objectivesEn: Name the 6 big platforms
Use 关注/点赞/评论/转发
Understand 粉丝/大V/网红/博主
Grasp 翻墙 in context

cecr-b12-med-m4.introTitleEn: Fake news: vocabulary to verify info
cecr-b12-med-m4.introContentEn:
假新闻 (jiǎ xīnwén) has become a major topic on Chinese networks.

- Vocabulary: 谣言 (yáoyán), 辟谣 (pìyáo) (to debunk a rumor), 真相 (zhēnxiàng), 真实 (zhēnshí), 可信 (kěxìn), 来源 (láiyuán), 证据 (zhèngjù).
- Questions to ask: 这条新闻的来源是哪里 (zhè tiáo xīnwén de láiyuán shì nǎlǐ)? (what's the source?), 有没有证据 (yǒu méiyǒu zhèngjù)? (is there evidence?), 是谁发布的 (shì shéi fābù de)? (who published it?).
- Critical verbs: 相信 (xiāngxìn), 怀疑 (huáiyí), 确认 (quèrèn), 证实 (zhèngshí).

A typical Chinese phenomenon: 标题党 (biāotídǎng) ('headline cult' — clickbait sites). Worth knowing: 澎湃新闻 (Péngpài Xīnwén), 新华社 (Xīnhuáshè) (Xinhua agency, official), 财新 (Cáixīn).
objectivesEn: Name 谣言 / 辟谣 / 真相
Question a source (来源, 证据)
Use 怀疑 / 确认 / 证实
Recognize 标题党

cecr-b12-med-m5.introContentEn:
Chinese advertising (广告, guǎnggào) uses short formulas, often rhythmic in 4 characters, sometimes in verse.

- Vocabulary: 品牌 (pǐnpái), 标志 (biāozhì) / 标识 (biāoshí), 口号 (kǒuhào), 优惠 (yōuhuì), 打折 (dǎzhé), 限时 (xiànshí), 免费 (miǎnfèi).
- Major shopping events: 双十一 (Shuāng Shíyī) (the '11/11' Singles' Day, the world's biggest shopping day), 618 (JD's June 18 anniversary sale), 双十二 (Shuāng Shí'èr) (12/12).
- Classic sales pitches: 性价比高 (xìngjiàbǐ gāo) (good value for money — the king-word of Chinese commerce), 限量 (xiànliàng), 爆款 (bàokuǎn).
- Selling influencers: 带货主播 (dàihuò zhǔbō) (live-sellers, a huge phenomenon in China).
- Rising local brands: 李宁 (Lǐníng), 华为 (Huáwèi), 大疆 (Dàjiāng), 比亚迪 (Bǐyàdí).
objectivesEn: Decode 品牌 / 口号 / 优惠 / 打折
Know 双十一 / 618
Use 性价比 / 限量 / 爆款
Grasp 带货主播

cecr-b12-conversation-m1.introTitleEn: Reviewing a film or book with structure
cecr-b12-conversation-m1.introContentEn:
Giving a structured opinion on a book, film or restaurant is a key B2 skill.

- Structured positive: 我觉得这本书写得很好，特别是 X (wǒ juéde zhè běn shū xiě de hěn hǎo, tèbié shì X).
- Give: 优点是… (yōudiǎn shì…) / 缺点是… (quēdiǎn shì…).
- Qualify: 总体来说不错，但是… (zǒngtǐ lái shuō búcuò, dànshì…).
- Vocab: 情节 (qíngjié) / 人物 (rénwù) / 节奏 (jiézòu) / 表演 (biǎoyǎn) / 剧本 (jùběn) / 风格 (fēnggé).
- Strong praise: 这部电影看完让我想了很久 (zhè bù diànyǐng kàn wán ràng wǒ xiǎng le hěn jiǔ).
- Rating: 五星 (wǔ xīng) / 四星 (sì xīng), 推荐 (tuījiàn) / 不推荐 (bù tuījiàn), 值得 (zhíde) / 不值得 (bù zhíde).
- Scale: 不错 (búcuò) < 很好 (hěn hǎo) < 太棒了 (tài bàng le) < 神作 (shénzuò).
- Avoid: 烂 (làn) / 垃圾 (lājī) → prefer 不太理想 (bù tài lǐxiǎng) / 期待落空 (qīdài luòkōng).

On 大众点评 (Dàzhòng Diǎnpíng) or 豆瓣 (Dòubàn), a 3-part format: rating + strengths + weaknesses.
objectivesEn: Review in 3 parts: rating + 优点 + 缺点
Use 情节 / 人物 / 节奏 / 风格
Recommend with 值得 + 推荐
Avoid 烂 / 垃圾 (vulgar)

cecr-b12-conversation-m2.introTitleEn: 怀念: talking about memories with nostalgia
cecr-b12-conversation-m2.introContentEn:
Evoking memories in Chinese involves a few nostalgia formulas deeply rooted in the culture.

- Start: 我还记得 (wǒ hái jìde) / 那时候我们… (nà shíhou wǒmen…) / 想起来真怀念 (xiǎng qǐlái zhēn huáiniàn).
- 怀念 (huáiniàn) = THE nostalgia keyword: 我很怀念那段时光 (wǒ hěn huáiniàn nà duàn shíguāng).
- Childhood: 小时候我经常… (xiǎoshíhou wǒ jīngcháng…).
- Ritual phrase: 时间过得真快啊，转眼就… (shíjiān guò de zhēn kuài a, zhuǎnyǎn jiù…).
- Evoking an object/photo: 这张照片让我想起 X (zhè zhāng zhàopiàn ràng wǒ xiǎng qǐ X) / 这个东西陪了我很多年 (zhège dōngxi péi le wǒ hěn duō nián) / 充满回忆 (chōngmǎn huíyì).
- Conclude: 那都是过去的事了 (nà dōu shì guòqù de shì le) / 现在好好过 (xiànzài hǎohǎo guò).

Poetic phrase: 时光荏苒 (shíguāng rěnrǎn).

- On WeChat Moments, format: an old photo + 陪了我很多年 (péi le wǒ hěn duō nián) + 🥹.
objectivesEn: Use 怀念 (emotional word)
React to the ritual 时间过得真快
Evoke a photo: 让我想起 X
Moments format: 陪了我多年

cecr-b12-conversation-m3.introTitleEn: Arguing about a sensitive topic tactfully
cecr-b12-conversation-m3.introContentEn:
Debating social topics in Chinese needs a clear structure and awareness of sensitive themes.

- Common topics: 教育 (jiàoyù) / 环境 (huánjìng) / 工作压力 (gōngzuò yālì) / 房价 (fángjià) / 老龄化 (lǎolínghuà).
- Structure: 我觉得 (wǒ juéde) + position + 因为 (yīnwèi) + reason + 比如 (bǐrú) + example + 不过 (búguò) + nuance.
- Vocab: 现象 (xiànxiàng) / 趋势 (qūshì) / 影响 (yǐngxiǎng) / 解决 (jiějué) / 改善 (gǎishàn).
- Polite opening: 这是个复杂的问题 (zhè shì gè fùzá de wèntí) / 这个问题没有简单的答案 (zhège wèntí méiyǒu jiǎndān de dá'àn).

SENSITIVE TOPICS: politics, recent history, Taiwan — prefer '我对这个不太了解 (wǒ duì zhège bù tài liǎojiě)' with strangers.

- Delicate: 抑郁症 (yìyùzhèng) / 焦虑 (jiāolǜ) / 离婚 (líhūn) / 丁克 (dīngkè) / 不婚主义 (bùhūn zhǔyì).
- Preface: 我可以问你一个比较私人的问题吗 (wǒ kěyǐ wèn nǐ yī gè bǐjiào sīrén de wèntí ma)? Exit: 你不想聊就不聊 (nǐ bù xiǎng liáo jiù bù liáo) (essential at B1+).
objectivesEn: Argue in 4 steps: position → reason → example → nuance
Navigate sensitive topics with 我不太了解
Preface a private topic: 我可以问吗?
Offer 你不想聊就不聊

cecr-b12-conversation-m4.introTitleEn: Telling a travel story and handling a mishap
cecr-b12-conversation-m4.introContentEn:
Telling a travel story and handling transport hiccups in Chinese relies on well-targeted practical vocabulary.

- Start: 我刚从 X 回来 (wǒ gāng cóng X huílái) / 我去 X 玩了一周 (wǒ qù X wán le yī zhōu).
- Adjectives: 美 (měi) / 壮观 (zhuàngguān) / 古老 (gǔlǎo) / 现代 (xiàndài) / 热闹 (rènao) / 安静 (ānjìng).
- Tips: 你一定要去 (nǐ yídìng yào qù) / 我推荐 X (wǒ tuījiàn X) / 别错过 X (bié cuòguò X).
- Praise phrases: 那里的人很热情 (nàlǐ de rén hěn rèqíng) / 当地的菜很地道 (dāngdì de cài hěn dìdao).
- Mishap: 行李 (xíngli) / 丢 (diū) / 找不到 (zhǎo bù dào) / 错过 (cuòguò) / 晚点 (wǎndiǎn) / 取消 (qǔxiāo).
- 我的行李丢了 (wǒ de xíngli diū le) / 我错过了航班 (wǒ cuòguò le hángbān).
- Help: 你能帮我吗 (nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma) + 不好意思 (bù hǎoyìsi) + cause.
- Conclude positively: 不过总体来说挺有意思 (búguò zǒngtǐ lái shuō tǐng yǒu yìsi).

If a real problem: see 工作人员 (gōngzuò rényuán), more effective.
objectivesEn: Describe a trip: 美 / 壮观 / 热闹 / 古老
Compliment with 当地的菜很地道 / 人热情
Handle a hiccup: 行李丢了 / 错过航班
Conclude resiliently: 不过总体来说挺有意思

cecr-b12-conversation-m5.introTitleEn: Talking about studies and asking for help
cecr-b12-conversation-m5.introContentEn:
Talking about schooling and studies in China requires knowing the system and its key vocabulary.

- Levels: 小学 (xiǎoxué) / 初中 (chūzhōng) / 高中 (gāozhōng) / 大学 (dàxué) / 硕士 (shuòshì) / 博士 (bóshì).
- Degrees: 本科生 (běnkēshēng) / 研究生 (yánjiūshēng) / 毕业生 (bìyèshēng).
- Verbs: 上课 (shàngkè) / 上学 (shàngxué) / 考试 (kǎoshì) / 复习 (fùxí) / 通过 (tōngguò) / 不及格 (bù jígé).

Hot topic: 高考 (gāokǎo) (the equivalent of the final exam but COLOSSAL in China — instantly understood and loaded).

- Asking a Chinese person 你高考考了多少分 (nǐ gāokǎo kǎo le duōshao fēn)? = OK and common.
- Difficulty: 我有点跟不上 (wǒ yǒudiǎn gēn bù shàng) / 我没听懂 (wǒ méi tīng dǒng).
- Help: 你能给我讲一下吗 (nǐ néng gěi wǒ jiǎng yíxià ma)?
- Study together: 一起复习 (yìqǐ fùxí) / 互相帮助 (hùxiāng bāngzhù).
- Encouragement: 失败是成功之母 (shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ) / 慢慢来 (mànmàn lái) / 别给自己太大压力 (bié gěi zìjǐ tài dà yālì).
objectivesEn: Know the 6 school levels
Understand the stakes of the 高考
Ask for help: 你能给我讲一下吗?
Encourage with 失败是成功之母

cecr-b12-conversation-m6.introTitleEn: Telling of a failure + presenting a plan B
cecr-b12-conversation-m6.introContentEn:
Talking about a past failure or presenting a structured plan are two skills valued in a Chinese professional context.

- Humble failure: 我之前犯过一个错误 (wǒ zhīqián fàn guò yī gè cuòwù) / 那次经历让我学到很多 (nà cì jīnglì ràng wǒ xué dào hěn duō).

Chinese people VALUE a lucid failure story (a sign of 成熟, maturity).

- Vocab: 失败 (shībài) / 教训 (jiàoxùn) / 反思 (fǎnsī) / 改进 (gǎijìn).
- Phrase: 这个教训我永远记得 (zhège jiàoxùn wǒ yǒngyuǎn jìde) / 现在回头看，那次失败是宝贵的 (xiànzài huítóu kàn, nà cì shībài shì bǎoguì de).

In a Chinese interview, '你最大的失败是什么 (nǐ zuì dà de shībài shì shénme)?' expects a real answer + lesson.

- Strategy: 目标 (mùbiāo) → 计划 (jìhuà) → 步骤 (bùzhòu) → 风险 (fēngxiǎn) → 备选方案 (bèixuǎn fāng'àn).
- Plan vocab: 实施 (shíshī) / 执行 (zhíxíng) / 评估 (pínggū) / 调整 (tiáozhěng).
- Anticipate: 关于风险，我们考虑过 X (guānyú fēngxiǎn, wǒmen kǎolǜ guò X).

ALWAYS present a plan B in a Chinese meeting.
objectivesEn: Tell of a failure + lesson (sign of 成熟)
Prepare 你最大的失败是什么 for interviews
Present in 5 steps: 目标→备选方案
ALWAYS have a 备选方案 (plan B)

cecr-b12-conversation-m7.introTitleEn: Pro feedback and polite disagreement with a superior
cecr-b12-conversation-m7.introContentEn:
Giving and receiving feedback in a Chinese professional setting follows strict cultural codes.

- Give positive: 我觉得你做得很好，特别是 X (wǒ juéde nǐ zuò de hěn hǎo, tèbié shì X).
- Constructive (sandwich mandatory): 你有几个优点，比如 X，不过 Y 可以再改进 (nǐ yǒu jǐ gè yōudiǎn, bǐrú X, búguò Y kěyǐ zài gǎijìn).
- Receive: 谢谢你的反馈 (xièxie nǐ de fǎnkuì) / 我会认真考虑 (wǒ huì rènzhēn kǎolǜ) / 你能再具体一点吗 (nǐ néng zài jùtǐ yīdiǎn ma)?

PUBLIC negative feedback = TABOO in Chinese pro culture — prefer 1-on-1 or private WeChat.

- Disagreeing with a superior: 我有一个不同的想法，您看一下 (wǒ yǒu yī gè bùtóng de xiǎngfǎ, nín kàn yíxià).
- Always as a QUESTION: 我们是不是可以考虑 X (wǒmen shì bùshì kěyǐ kǎolǜ X)?
- Stress the risk, not the superior: 这个方案有一个潜在的风险 (zhège fāng'àn yǒu yī gè qiánzài de fēngxiǎn).
- Magic sentence: 我只是从我的角度提一个建议 (wǒ zhǐshì cóng wǒ de jiǎodù tí yī gè jiànyì).

If refused, don't insist out loud, come back with a file 1-2 days later.
objectivesEn: Feedback sandwich: positive + area to improve
Prefer 1-on-1 or WeChat for criticism
Disagree as a QUESTION: 我们是不是可以…
Magic sentence: 我只是从我的角度提一个建议

cecr-b12-nuances-m1.introTitleEn: 刚/刚才/马上/立刻/立即: time getting precise
cecr-b12-nuances-m1.introContentEn:
Five time adverbs often confused — two for the recent past, three for the immediate.

**刚 vs 刚才:**

- **刚** (gāng) = just now (adverb, **before the verb**): 我刚到 (wǒ gāng dào) = I've just arrived.
- **刚才** (gāngcái) = a moment ago (a time noun, **free position**): 刚才你说什么 (gāngcái nǐ shuō shénme)?
- Mnemonic: 刚 = just now; 刚才 = a few minutes ago.

**马上/立刻/立即 — from softest to most formal:**

- **马上** (mǎshàng) = spoken standard, elastic (~5-15 min in China).
- **立刻** (lìkè) = a bit more serious (1-2 min).
- **立即** (lìjí) = formal, an imperative order.

**Cultural note:** a Chinese person's 马上来 can mean... 15 minutes. Plan ahead.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 刚 (adverb) vs 刚才 (noun)
Understand 马上 = ~10 min (elastic)
Reserve 立即 for formal orders
Position: 刚 before verb, 刚才 free

cecr-b12-nuances-m2.introTitleEn: 完成/结束/完毕 and 终于/最后/到底
cecr-b12-nuances-m2.introContentEn:
完成 (wánchéng), 结束 (jiéshù) and 完毕 (wánbì) all mean 'to finish', but their use depends on the type of ending and the register.

- 完成 (wánchéng) = to complete (a GOAL, result): 我完成了任务 (wǒ wánchéng le rènwù).
- 结束 (jiéshù) = to end (an EVENT, neutral): 会议结束了 (huìyì jiéshù le).
- 完毕 (wánbì) = completed (FORMAL, military/admin): 报告完毕 (bàogào wánbì).
- Mistake: 会议完成了 (huìyì wánchéng le) ✗ → 结束 (jiéshù).
- 终于 (zhōngyú) = FINALLY (emotional relief +): 我终于到了 (wǒ zhōngyú dào le).
- 最后 (zuìhòu) = at the end (NEUTRAL, sequence).
- 到底 (dàodǐ) = in the end / after all (insistence, sometimes annoyance): 你到底来不来 (nǐ dàodǐ lái bù lái)?

Avoid 到底 (dàodǐ) with a superior — 到底 (dàodǐ) + question = impatience.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 完成 (result) / 结束 (event) / 完毕 (formal)
Tell apart 终于 (emotion+) / 最后 (neutral) / 到底 (insistence)
Avoid 到底 + question with a superior
Choose the right 'finish' verb by context

cecr-b12-nuances-m3.introTitleEn: 难道 and 不一定: disbelief and nuance
cecr-b12-nuances-m3.introContentEn:
Two sets to express doubt and nuance.

**Disbelief — from most neutral to strongest:**

- 真的吗 (zhēn de ma)? = really? (neutral).
- **不会吧** (bù huì ba) = no way! (casual spoken).
- **难道** (nándào) = don't tell me that... (strongly rhetorical): 难道你不知道 (nándào nǐ bù zhīdào)?
- 怎么可能 (zěnme kěnéng) = how is that possible?

**Hierarchy:** 真的吗 < 不会吧 < 难道 < 怎么可能.

**Softened negation — 'not necessarily':**

- **不一定** (bù yídìng) = not necessarily (neutral, universal).
- **不见得** (bújiàndé) = not sure at all (skeptical tone).
- **未必** (wèibì) = maybe not (formal/written).

**Practical rule:** with a superior, choose 不一定. In writing, alternate 不一定/未必.
objectivesEn: Choose 难道 (strong) vs 不会吧 (spoken)
Tell apart 不一定 / 不见得 / 未必 by register
Prefer 不一定 (neutral) with a superior
Recognize 难道 = Chinese drama

cecr-b12-nuances-m4.introTitleEn: 趁/利用/借 and 便/即 in context
cecr-b12-nuances-m4.introContentEn:
Three verbs for 'to take advantage of' — each has a different affective value.

- **趁** (chèn) = to seize a **positive** opportunity (spoken): 趁热吃 (chèn rè chī), 趁年轻多去看看世界 (chèn niánqīng duō qù kànkan shìjiè).
- **利用** (lìyòng) = to use (neutral for resources, negative for people): 利用资源 (lìyòng zīyuán) ✓, 利用别人 (lìyòng biérén) = to exploit.
- **借** (jiè) = to seize the occasion (formal): 借这个机会 (jiè zhège jīhuì) = to take this opportunity.

**Formal connectors to recognize in writing:**

- **便** (biàn) = then / thus (a formal synonym of 就) — never in speech.
- **即** (jí) = that is / immediately (depending on context) — never in speech.
- 即所谓 X (jí suǒwèi X) = that is what's called X.

B1.2 strategy: **recognize** 便/即 for reading; don't **produce** them in speech.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 趁 (positive) vs 利用 (neutral/negative) vs 借 (formal)
Warm phrase: 趁年轻多去看看世界
Recognize 便 / 即 in pro/news writing
NEVER say 即 in spontaneous speech

cecr-b12-nuances-m5.introTitleEn: 把 vs 将 and the three 的/地/得
cecr-b12-nuances-m5.introContentEn:
Two topics in one: the disposal 把/将, and the three particles 的/地/得.

**把 vs 将:**

- **把** (bǎ) = standard disposal, spoken and written: 把书放在桌上 (bǎ shū fàng zài zhuō shàng).
- **将** (jiāng) = same function but **formal** (admin, press, legal): 将文件交给经理 (jiāng wénjiàn jiāo gěi jīnglǐ).
- 将 also has a formal future sense: 将来 (jiānglái) / 即将 (jíjiāng).
- **Never 将 in spontaneous speech.**

**The three 的/地/得:**

- **的** + noun: 漂亮的衣服 (piàoliang de yīfu) = beautiful clothes.
- **地** + verb: 慢慢地走 (mànmàn de zǒu) = walk slowly.
- **得** + complement: 走得很快 (zǒu de hěn kuài) = walk fast.

**Golden rule:** 的 = thing / 地 = manner / 得 = result.
objectivesEn: Build 把 + obj + verb + result
Recognize 将 in pro writing
Tell apart 的 / 地 / 得 (3 'de')
Memorize: 的 thing / 地 manner / 得 result

cecr-b12-nuances-m6.introTitleEn: 在…的时候 / 当…时 and if/when by register
cecr-b12-nuances-m6.introContentEn:
Two pairs to master: 'when' by register, and 'if' by degree of certainty.

**When:**

- **在…的时候** = spoken standard and natural: 在我学中文的时候 (zài wǒ xué Zhōngwén de shíhou).
- **当…时** = formal, written: 当我看到他时 (dāng wǒ kàn dào tā shí).
- **当…的时候** = universal combo (spoken and written).
- **Never** 时 (shí) alone in speech.
- **在…期间** = during (for **periods**): 在会议期间 (zài huìyì qījiān).

**If — from softest to most serious:**

- **要是** (yàoshi) = casual spoken.
- **如果** (rúguǒ) = standard.
- **假如** (jiǎrú) = formal.
- **一旦** (yídàn) = once / if ever (irreversible).
- **万一** (wànyī) = in case — very useful for polite precautions.
objectivesEn: Choose 在…的时候 (spoken) vs 当…时 (written)
Build 在…期间 for a PERIOD
Tell apart 如果 (neutral) / 一旦 (irreversible)
Use 万一 for precautions

cecr-b12-nuances-m7.introTitleEn: 每…都 and 所有/一切/全部: saying 'all'
cecr-b12-nuances-m7.introContentEn:
Four ways to say 'all' — each has its context.

**每 + 都 (mandatory) = each:**

- 每个人都喜欢 (měi gèrén dōu xǐhuan) = everyone likes it.
- 每天我都去跑步 (měitiān wǒ dōu qù pǎobù).
- **Never forget 都 after 每.**

**所有 = all (neutral, the most universal):**

- 所有人都来了 (suǒyǒu rén dōu lái le) = everyone came.

**一切 = everything (abstract, emotional, literary):**

- 我愿意为你做一切 (wǒ yuànyì wèi nǐ zuò yīqiè) = I'd do anything for you.
- **Pitfall:** 一切人 ✗ — for people, use 所有人.

**全部 = the whole (neutral, quantifiable):**

- 全部完成了 (quánbù wánchéng le) = it's all done.

**Universality hierarchy:** 每 < 任何 < 凡是 (formal written).
objectivesEn: Systematically pair 每 + 都
Tell apart 所有 (list) / 一切 (abstract) / 全部 (whole)
Recognize 我愿意为你做一切 (declaration)
Rank 每 / 任何 / 凡是

cecr-b21-grammar-lian-m1.introTitleEn: 连…也/都: even X falls under the rule
cecr-b21-grammar-lian-m1.introContentEn:
连 (lián)…也/都 highlights an **unexpected or extreme** element to amplify an assertion or a negation.

**Structure:** 连 + noun (extreme/surprising) + 也/都 + verb

- 连小孩也知道 (lián xiǎohái yě zhīdào) = even a child knows.
- 也 and 都 are interchangeable in this structure.

**In the negative** — to maximize an absence:

- 他连一句话也没说 (tā lián yī jù huà yě méi shuō) = he didn't say **a single** word.
- Without 连: 他没说话 = neutral. With 连: you stress the total extent.

**Choosing an 'extreme' noun** boosts the effect: 连小孩 (even a child), 连一分钱 (even one cent), 连名字 (even the name).
objectivesEn: Build 连 + N + 也/都 + V
Use 连 in the negative to maximize
Tell apart with/without 连
Choose a fitting 'extreme' noun

cecr-b21-grammar-lian-m2.introTitleEn: 连 + V + 也没 + V: 'didn't even do it'
cecr-b21-grammar-lian-m2.introContentEn:
Verbal variant: the verb is **repeated** on either side of 也/都 to say 'didn't even do X'.

**Structure:** 连 + V + 也/都 + 没 + V

- 他连看也没看一眼 (tā lián kàn yě méi kàn yī yǎn) = he didn't even glance.
- 我连想也没想过 (wǒ lián xiǎng yě méi xiǎng guò) = I never even thought about it.

**Common verbs with this structure:** 看 (kàn), 想 (xiǎng), 说 (shuō), 听 (tīng), 试 (shì).

This structure is **idiomatic** — you can't translate it word for word. In English: 'not even' or 'not once'. Very frequent in speech for indignation or surprise.
objectivesEn: Form 连 + V + 也 + 没 + V
Use with 看/想/说/听
Express indignation/surprise
Understand the repeated verb

cecr-b21-grammar-lian-m3.introTitleEn: 除了…以外 + 也/还 or 都: it all depends what follows
cecr-b21-grammar-lian-m3.introContentEn:
除了 (chúle) X 以外 (yǐwài) means 'apart from X', but the final meaning depends entirely on the conjunction that follows.

- With 还 (hái)/也 (yě): 除了中文以外，我也会英文 (chúle Zhōngwén yǐwài, wǒ yě huì yīngwén) (I ALSO speak English → both).
- With 都 (dōu) + negation: 除了小王以外，大家都来了 (chúle Xiǎo Wáng yǐwài, dàjiā dōu lái le) (Xiao Wang is excluded, the others came).

以外 (yǐwài) is often droppable, but keeping the full structure is safer at first. Pitfall: confusing inclusion and exclusion gives exactly the opposite of the intended meaning.
objectivesEn: Use 除了…以外 + 也/还 (inclusion)
Use 除了…以外 + 都 (exclusion)
Choose by the intended meaning
Build complete sentences

cecr-b21-grammar-conj-m1.introTitleEn: 不但…而且: 'not only… but also'
cecr-b21-grammar-conj-m1.introContentEn:
不但 (búdàn)…而且 (érqiě) builds a **positive gradation** — the second element is even better or stronger.

- 他不但聪明，而且努力 (tā búdàn cōngmíng, érqiě nǔlì) = he is not only smart, but also hard-working.

**Subject position:**

- Same subject → place it **before** 不但: 他不但聪明而且努力.
- Different subjects → each after its connector: 不但他会来，而且他妈妈也会来 (búdàn tā huì lái, érqiě tā māma yě huì lái).

**Variants by register:**

- 不仅 (bùjǐn) = 不但 (more written).
- 而且/并且/也/还 in the second part — a crescendo of formality.

**Pitfall:** don't use 也 twice (redundancy).
objectivesEn: Build 不但 A 而且 B
Place the subject correctly
Use 不仅/并且 as variants
Avoid redundancy with 也

cecr-b21-grammar-conj-m2.introTitleEn: 无论/不管…都: no matter X, Y
cecr-b21-grammar-conj-m2.introContentEn:
无论 (wúlùn) / 不管 (bùguǎn) + a question + **都/也** = 'no matter X, Y'.

**Rule:** an **embedded question** must follow — a question word or the alternative A 还是 B.

- 无论谁来，我都欢迎 (wúlùn shéi lái, wǒ dōu huānyíng) = no matter who comes.
- 不管你说什么，他都不听 (bùguǎn nǐ shuō shénme, tā dōu bù tīng) = whatever you say.
- 无论天气好不好，我们都去 (wúlùn tiānqì hǎo bùhǎo, wǒmen dōu qù) = rain or shine.

**都 (dōu) in the second part is mandatory.**

**Register:** 无论 = written/formal; 不管 = spoken standard.

**Pitfall:** without a question or alternative, 无论 is grammatically incorrect.
objectivesEn: Build 无论/不管 + 谁/什么/哪/怎么 + 都
Use A 还是 B as an alternative
Choose 无论 (written) vs 不管 (spoken)
Never forget 都/也

cecr-b21-grammar-conj-m3.introTitleEn: 即使…也: 'even if' for a hypothesis
cecr-b21-grammar-conj-m3.introContentEn:
即使 (jíshǐ)…也 (yě) introduces a **hypothetical concession**: the mentioned event may not happen.

- 即使下雨，我也去 (jíshǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě qù) = even if it rains, I'm going.

**Crucial distinction from 虽然:**

- 虽然下雨了，我还是去了 = although it rained (a **real** fact).
- 即使下雨，我也去 = even if it rains (a **hypothetical** event).

**Variants by register:**

- 就算 (jiùsuàn) = casual spoken.
- 哪怕 (nǎpà) = extreme case, emotional tone.
- 即便 (jíbiàn) = formal/written.

**也 in the second part is mandatory** — the learner's no.1 mistake.
objectivesEn: Build 即使 A 也 B
Tell apart 即使 vs 虽然
Use 就算 in speech
Use 哪怕 for an extreme case

cecr-b21-grammar-conj-m4.introTitleEn: 虽然 vs 尽管: nuance of effort and tone
cecr-b21-grammar-conj-m4.introContentEn:
虽然 (suīrán) and 尽管 (jǐnguǎn) both mean 'although' BUT: 虽然 (suīrán) introduces a fact accepted neutrally (虽然下雨了，但是我们还是去了 — 'although it rained, we still went'). 尽管 (jǐnguǎn) has a nuance of emphatic concession, often with the idea of effort despite the obstacle (尽管很累，他还是坚持 — 'although exhausted, he perseveres'). 尽管 (jǐnguǎn) can also mean 'feel free to' in 你尽管说 (nǐ jǐnguǎn shuō) ('speak freely'). Both are paired with 但是 (dànshì)/可是 (kěshì)/然而 (rán'ér)/还是 (háishi) in the second part.

Pitfall: 尽管 (jǐnguǎn) alone (without a second clause) = 'feel free', a totally different meaning.
objectivesEn: Use 虽然…但是 (neutral)
Use 尽管…还是 (with effort)
Tell apart 尽管 conj. vs 尽管 adv.
Add 但是/可是/然而

cecr-b21-tech-m1.introContentEn:
Hardware: 电脑 (diànnǎo), 手机 (shǒujī), 屏幕 (píngmù), 键盘 (jiànpán), 鼠标 (shǔbiāo).

- Internet: 网络 (wǎngluò)/网 (wǎng), 网站 (wǎngzhàn), 网页 (wǎngyè), 浏览器 (liúlǎnqì), 密码 (mìmǎ), 账号 (zhànghào).
- Actions: 上网 (shàngwǎng), 下载 (xiàzài), 登录 (dēnglù), 注册 (zhùcè).

Note: in China, 微信 (wēixìn) replaces most Western services — messaging, payment, ID, mini-programs.
objectivesEn: Name hardware and network
Use 上网/下载/登录/注册
Understand WeChat's place
Pronounce the neologisms

cecr-b21-tech-m2.introTitleEn: 人工智能: AI and data in China
cecr-b21-tech-m2.introContentEn:
人工智能 (réngōng zhìnéng) — literally 'human-made intelligence'. China develops its own large models: Baidu's Ernie, 通义千问 (Tōngyì Qiānwèn, Alibaba's Qwen), DeepSeek.

**Key vocabulary:**

- 算法 (suànfǎ) = algorithm.
- 数据 (shùjù) = data.
- 大数据 (dà shùjù) = Big Data.
- 云/云计算 (yún/yún jìsuàn) = cloud / cloud computing.

**Social stakes:**

- 隐私 (yǐnsī) = privacy.
- 监控 (jiānkòng) = surveillance.
- 人脸识别 (rén liǎn shíbié) = facial recognition — ubiquitous in Chinese cities, a source of heated debate.
objectivesEn: Decode 人工智能/算法/数据
Name Chinese LLMs
Debate 隐私/监控
Use 大数据/云计算

cecr-b21-tech-m3.introTitleEn: 支付宝/微信支付: cashless China
cecr-b21-tech-m3.introContentEn:
China has nearly eliminated cash via 支付宝 (Zhīfùbǎo) and 微信支付 (Wēixìn Zhīfù).

- Actions: 扫码 (sǎomǎ) (scan a QR code), 付款 (fùkuǎn), 转账 (zhuǎnzhàng).
- Platforms: 淘宝 (Táobǎo) (the 'Chinese eBay'), 京东 (Jīngdōng), 拼多多 (Pīnduōduō).
- Ultra-fast delivery: 快递 (kuàidì), 外卖 (wàimài) (meal delivery — Meituan and Ele.me dominate).
- Keywords: 双十一 (Shuāng Shíyī) ('Double 11', Singles' Day = the world's biggest shopping day).
objectivesEn: Use 扫码/付款/转账
Know 淘宝/京东/拼多多
Order via 外卖
Understand 双十一

cecr-b21-tech-m4.introTitleEn: 5G and 共享: the connected infrastructure
cecr-b21-tech-m4.introContentEn:
China rolled out 5G massively ahead of the West. A strategic tension exists around 华为 (Huáwèi), the world's 5G leader.

- Terms: 5G网络 (wǔjí wǎngluò, 5G network), 物联网 (wùliánwǎng, IoT — literally 'internet of things'), 智慧城市 (zhìhuì chéngshì).
- Connected devices: 智能家居 (zhìnéng jiājū), 智能音箱 (zhìnéng yīnxiāng, smart speaker — like Xiaomi's or Alibaba's 天猫精灵 Tiānmāo Jīnglíng).
- Mobility: 共享 (gòngxiǎng) — 共享单车 (gòngxiǎng dānchē) (bike-sharing, like Meituan's), 共享充电宝 (gòngxiǎng chōngdiànbǎo) (shared power banks).
objectivesEn: Talk about 5G/物联网/智慧城市
Describe 智能家居/智能音箱
Use 共享 in the economy
Understand the Huawei tension

cecr-b21-env-m1.introTitleEn: 雾霾 and pollution: China's fight
cecr-b21-env-m1.introContentEn:
In 2013-2015, Beijing's AQI regularly topped 500 — 20 times the WHO threshold. The 雾霾 (wùmái, brown smog) was visible from space.

**Pollution vocabulary:**

- 污染 (wūrǎn) = pollution.
- 空气污染 (kōngqì wūrǎn) = air pollution.
- 雾霾 (wùmái) = smog, polluted haze.
- 空气质量 (kōngqì zhìliàng) = air quality.
- PM2.5 = universal indicator.

**Individual responses:** 口罩 (kǒuzhào), 空气净化器 (kōngqì jìnghuàqì).

**National policies:** 环保 (huánbǎo) = environmental protection; 减排 (jiǎnpái) = emissions reduction. China is now the **world's no.1** in solar and wind power.
objectivesEn: Talk about 污染/雾霾/PM2.5
Describe 空气质量
Name 口罩/空气净化器
Use 环保/减排

cecr-b21-env-m2.introTitleEn: 气候变化: the 2030 and 2060 targets
cecr-b21-env-m2.introContentEn:
气候变化 (qìhòu biànhuà), 全球变暖 (quánqiú biànnuǎn).

- Causes: 温室气体 (wēnshì qìtǐ, greenhouse gases), 二氧化碳 (èryǎnghuàtàn, CO2).

Consequences: 冰川融化 (bīngchuān rónghuà), 海平面上升 (hǎi píngmiàn shàngshēng), 极端天气 (jíduān tiānqì). China's target: 碳达峰 (tàn dá fēng) (carbon peak) by 2030 and 碳中和 (tàn zhōnghé) (carbon neutrality) by 2060 — announced by Xi Jinping in 2020.
objectivesEn: Use 气候变化/全球变暖
Cite 温室气体/二氧化碳
Describe the consequences
Know 碳达峰/碳中和 2030/2060

cecr-b21-env-m3.introTitleEn: 垃圾分类: waste sorting the Chinese way
cecr-b21-env-m3.introContentEn:
In July 2019, Shanghai imposed strict 垃圾分类 (lājī fēnlèi), unheard of in China. Fines for mistakes.

- Four categories: 可回收物 (kě huíshōu wù), 有害垃圾 (yǒuhài lājī), 湿垃圾 (shī lājī)/厨余垃圾 (chúyú lājī) (wet/kitchen waste), 干垃圾 (gān lājī)/其他垃圾 (qítā lājī).
- Useful vocabulary: 回收 (huíshōu), 环保袋 (huánbǎo dài), 一次性 (yícìxìng).

Debate: plastic bags 塑料袋 (sùliàodài), still ubiquitous in small shops.
objectivesEn: Sort into the 4 Chinese categories
Use 可回收/有害/湿/干
Understand 2019 Shanghai
Say 一次性/环保袋

cecr-b21-economics-m1.introTitleEn: 经济/通货膨胀/股市: macro in Chinese
cecr-b21-economics-m1.introContentEn:
经济 (jīngjì), 经济增长 (jīngjì zēngzhǎng), 经济危机 (jīngjì wēijī). Indicators: GDP → 国内生产总值 (guónèi shēngchǎn zǒngzhí) or the abbreviation GDP is widely used. 通货膨胀 (tōnghuò péngzhàng), 通货紧缩 (tōnghuò jǐnsuō).

- Market: 市场 (shìchǎng), 股市 (gǔshì), 股票 (gǔpiào).
- Banks: 银行 (yínháng), 利率 (lìlǜ), 贷款 (dàikuǎn).

China saw double-digit growth from 1990-2010, then a structural slowdown.
objectivesEn: Use 经济/增长/危机
Master 通货膨胀/通货紧缩
Talk about 股市/股票
Describe banks

cecr-b21-economics-m2.introTitleEn: 创业: Chinese start-ups and unicorns
cecr-b21-economics-m2.introContentEn:
创业 (chuàngyè) (to start a business, to be an entrepreneur), 创业者 (chuàngyèzhě), 创始人 (chuàngshǐrén), 企业家 (qǐyèjiā).

- Financing: 投资 (tóuzī), 风险投资 (fēngxiǎn tóuzī), 融资 (róngzī), 估值 (gūzhí), 独角兽 (dújiǎoshòu) (unicorn, > $1 billion).
- Structure: 公司 (gōngsī), 上市 (shàngshì) (to go public, IPO), 股东 (gǔdōng).
- Ecosystem: 中关村 (Zhōngguāncūn) ('Beijing's Silicon Valley'), 深圳 (Shēnzhèn).
objectivesEn: Use 创业/创始人/企业家
Talk about 风险投资/融资
Understand 独角兽/估值
Name 中关村/深圳

cecr-b21-economics-m3.introTitleEn: 996 and 关系: work culture in China
cecr-b21-economics-m3.introContentEn:
996: working from 9am to 9pm, 6 days a week, famous/notorious in Chinese tech — Jack Ma defended it in 2019 as a 'blessing'.

- Vocabulary: 职场 (zhíchǎng), 升职 (shēngzhí), 加薪 (jiāxīn), 跳槽 (tiàocáo) (to change jobs), 裁员 (cáiyuán), 失业 (shīyè).
- Roles: 老板 (lǎobǎn), 同事 (tóngshì), 下属 (xiàshǔ).

Culture: 关系 (guānxì) remains central to getting ahead, far more than merit alone.
objectivesEn: Understand 996 and its debate
Use 升职/加薪/跳槽/裁员
Name 老板/同事/下属
Explain 关系

cecr-b21-conversation-m1.introTitleEn: Running a meeting: 议题, 共识, 辛苦了
cecr-b21-conversation-m1.introContentEn:
To run a meeting in Mandarin, address participants by name — otherwise, out of hierarchy/shyness, few will speak up.

- Open: 大家好，我们今天的会议有 X 个议题 (dàjiā hǎo, wǒmen jīntiān de huìyì yǒu X gè yìtí).
- Refocus: 我们先回到主题 (wǒmen xiān huí dào zhǔtí).

Conclude: 我总结一下今天的讨论 (wǒ zǒngjié yíxià jīntiān de tǎolùn) → 我们达成了几个共识 (wǒmen dáchéng le jǐ gè gòngshí) → 接下来谁负责 X (jiē xiàlái shéi fùzé X) → 谢谢大家辛苦了 (xièxie dàjiā xīnkǔ le) (without a final 辛苦了, the meeting leaves a cold aftertaste). WeChat follow-up within 24h with a 会议纪要 (huìyì jìyào, meeting minutes) = the expected proof of commitment.
objectivesEn: Open with 议题 + 主持
Address participants by name
Conclude with 共识 + 负责 + 辛苦了
Send 会议纪要 within 24h

cecr-b21-conversation-m2.introContentEn:
The MAGIC formula of Chinese pro negotiation to push a price is more polite than 能再便宜一点 (néng zài piányi yīdiǎn) and is used like this: 这个价格我们觉得有点高，还有没有调整的空间 (zhège jiàgé wǒmen juéde yǒudiǎn gāo, háiyǒu méiyǒu tiáozhěng de kōngjiān)?

- Force their hand: 我们的预算有限 (wǒmen de yùsuàn yǒuxiàn) / 这是我们的最后报价 (zhè shì wǒmen de zuìhòu bàojià).
- Conclude: 我们达成协议了 (wǒmen dáchéng xiéyì le)!
- On terms: 条款 (tiáokuǎn), 期限 (qīxiàn), 责任 (zérèn), 违约 (wéiyuē).
- PITFALL: NEVER sign on the spot.
- Magic sentence: 我需要跟我的团队商量一下 (wǒ xūyào gēn wǒ de tuánduì shāngliáng yíxià) (buys time + shows seriousness).

Accepting the first price = losing respect in Chinese culture.
objectivesEn: Use 还有没有调整的空间
List 条款/期限/责任/违约
Defer with 我需要商量一下
Conclude with 达成协议

cecr-b21-conversation-m3.introTitleEn: Status update: always pair problem and solution
cecr-b21-conversation-m3.introContentEn:
GOLDEN RULE of Chinese pro life: raising a problem WITHOUT a solution = seen as a lack of initiative. Always pair a problem with a proposed solution.

- Structure: 项目目前的进度 (xiàngmù mùqián de jìndù) → 已完成 (yǐ wánchéng) → 正在进行 (zhèngzài jìnxíng) → 计划中 (jìhuà zhōng).
- If delayed: 因为 X，我们可能要延期一周 (yīnwèi X, wǒmen kěnéng yào yánqī yī zhōu).
- Always pair: 我有一个问题，我建议这样解决 X (wǒ yǒu yī gè wèntí, wǒ jiànyì zhèyàng jiějué X).
- Data: 增长 (zēngzhǎng) / 下降 (xiàjiàng) / 保持 (bǎochí) / 达到 (dádào).
- CRITICAL distinction: 增长了 5% (+5%) ≠ 增长了 5 个百分点 (gè bǎifēndiǎn) (went from X to X+5%).

Confusing these in a pro report = a serious error.
objectivesEn: Structure a status update in 4 steps
Always pair problem + solution
Quantify with 增长/下降/达到
Tell apart % vs 百分点

cecr-b21-conversation-m4.introTitleEn: Handling a conflict: 误会 and 我也有责任
cecr-b21-conversation-m4.introContentEn:
To handle a conflict, using 误会 (wùhuì) externalizes the cause — ALWAYS prefer it to 'you made a mistake'. Acknowledge your part: 我也有责任 (wǒ yě yǒu zérèn) (Chinese culture appreciates 50/50 even when the other is 80% at fault).

- Acknowledge: 我感觉我们之间有一些误会 (wǒ gǎnjué wǒmen zhī jiān yǒu yìxiē wùhuì).
- Sit down: 我们能不能坐下来好好聊一下 (wǒmen néng bù néng zuò xiàlái hǎohǎo liáo yíxià)?
- In mediation: 我不想偏袒任何一方 (wǒ bù xiǎng piāntǎn rènhé yī fāng), 我们能不能找一个双方都能接受的方案 (wǒmen néng bù néng zhǎo yī gè shuāngfāng dōu néng jiēshòu de fāng'àn)?

Seek an OPERATIONAL compromise > 'who's right'. Chinese culture values social peace > surface justice.
objectivesEn: Externalize the cause with 误会
Share responsibility with 我也有责任
Mediate with 不偏袒 + 双方
Seek an operational compromise

cecr-b21-conversation-m5.introTitleEn: WeChat networking: add, follow up, reactivate
cecr-b21-conversation-m5.introContentEn:
The BOND forms within 48h via 1-2 personalized messages. Without follow-up, the contact sleeps forever. The WeChat ritual (birthdays, articles, greetings) maintains 关系 (guānxì) over a year.

- Approach: 不好意思，可以加您一下微信吗 (bù hǎoyìsi, kěyǐ jiā nín yíxià wēixìn ma)?
- Seasonal wishes: 中秋节快乐 (Zhōngqiūjié kuàilè) / 春节快乐 (Chūnjié kuàilè) (sent to ALL Chinese pro contacts; absence = a negative mark).
- Reactivate a dormant relationship: 好久没联系，希望您一切都好 (hǎojiǔ méi liánxì, xīwàng nín yíqiè dōu hǎo).
- Ask a favor: 不好意思打扰您，最近有件事想麻烦您 (bù hǎoyìsi dǎrǎo nín, zuìjìn yǒu jiàn shì xiǎng máfan nín).
objectivesEn: Ask 加微信 politely
Follow up within 48h of adding
Send seasonal wishes (中秋/春节)
Reactivate with 好久没联系

cecr-b21-conversation-m6.introTitleEn: Formal speech: 各位领导 and 我以茶代酒
cecr-b21-conversation-m6.introContentEn:
Open: 各位领导，各位同事，下午好 (gèwèi lǐngdǎo, gèwèi tóngshì, xiàwǔ hǎo) — the hierarchy of address is MANDATORY (leaders first). The rule is to NEVER start drinking before the leader's toast — skipping this step = disrespect.

- Conclude: 我的发言到此结束，谢谢大家的聆听 (wǒ de fāyán dào cǐ jiéshù, xièxie dàjiā de língtīng) + 希望今天的内容对大家有所帮助 (xīwàng jīntiān de nèiróng duì dàjiā yǒu suǒ bāngzhù).
- Toast: 我提议大家举杯，为 X 干杯 (wǒ tíyì dàjiā jǔ bēi, wèi X gānbēi)!
- 干杯 (gānbēi) or 随意 (suíyì).
- If you don't drink: 我以茶代酒 (wǒ yǐ chá dài jiǔ) — a set, accepted formula.
objectivesEn: Open with 各位 + hierarchy
Conclude with 聆听 + 内容有所帮助
Toast with 举杯 + 干杯
Substitute 我以茶代酒 if abstaining

cecr-b21-conversation-m7.introTitleEn: Résumé and pro email: 尊敬的 / 此致敬礼
cecr-b21-conversation-m7.introContentEn:
The closing of a cover letter requires: 期待您的回复 (qīdài nín de huífù) + 此致 (cǐzhì) + 敬礼 (jìnglǐ). Pro email: a short subject, opening 您好 (nín hǎo) or 尊敬的 X (zūnjìng de X), a request with 麻烦您 (máfan nín), a FORMAL closing 此致 (cǐzhì)/敬礼 (jìnglǐ) or 顺祝商祺 (shùn zhù shāngqí) (wishes of prosperity — VERY classy).

- Cover letter: 尊敬的招聘负责人 (zūnjìng de zhāopìn fùzérén).
- Introduction: 我是 X，毕业于 X 大学，目前在 X 公司 (wǒ shì X, bìyè yú X dàxué, mùqián zài X gōngsī).
- Chinese résumé: ALWAYS add a photo (serious, plain background).
- No photo = incomplete (the opposite of the Western standard).
objectivesEn: Open a letter with 尊敬的 X
Close with 此致敬礼 (MANDATORY)
Master 顺祝商祺 in B2B email
Add a photo to a Chinese résumé

cecr-b21-nuances-m1.introTitleEn: 反正/无论如何 and 所以/因此/故 by register
cecr-b21-nuances-m1.introContentEn:
Two sets to rank: 'no matter what' and 'therefore'.

**'No matter what' — increasing register:**

- **反正** (fǎnzhèng) = spoken, blunt attitude: 反正我不去 = anyway I'm not going.
- **不管** (bùguǎn) = neutral conditional.
- **无论如何** (wúlùn rúhé) = formal, absolute commitment: 无论如何，我们必须完成 (wǒmen bìxū wánchéng).

**Pro rule:** avoid 反正 with a superior — it sounds indifferent.

**'Therefore' — increasing register:**

- **所以** (suǒyǐ) = spoken and written standard.
- **因此** (yīncǐ) = formal written.
- **因而** (yīn'ér) = elevated written.
- **故** (gù) = literary, quotations.

In speech: **所以**. In B2.1+ writing: alternate 因此/因而 for rhythm.
objectivesEn: Choose 反正 vs 无论如何 by register
Rank 所以 → 因此 → 因而 → 故
Use 无论如何 professionally (commitment)
Alternate 因此/因而 in an essay

cecr-b21-nuances-m2.introTitleEn: 关于/对于/至于 and 充分/充足/足够
cecr-b21-nuances-m2.introContentEn:
关于 (guānyú) (concerns the TOPIC, opens a theme) ≠ 对于 (duìyú) ≠ 至于 (zhìyú) (a CHANGE of subject/transition). 关于这个问题，我有几点想法 (guānyú zhège wèntí, wǒ yǒu jǐ diǎn xiǎngfǎ) / 对于这个问题，我的态度是… (duìyú zhège wèntí, wǒ de tàidù shì…) / 这是大原则。至于细节，我们以后讨论 (zhè shì dà yuánzé. zhìyú xìjié, wǒmen yǐhòu tǎolùn).

- Classic mistake: confusing 关于 (guānyú) and 对于 (duìyú).

充分准备 (chōngfèn zhǔnbèi) < 充足 (chōngzú) < 足够 (zúgòu) (simple spoken — 时间足够).

- Mistake: 时间充分 (shíjiān chōngfèn) ✗ → 时间足够 (shíjiān zúgòu) ✓.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 关于 (topic) vs 对于 (stance) vs 至于 (transition)
Choose 充分 (abstract) vs 充足 (concrete) vs 足够 (spoken)
Memorize collocations 充分准备/充足资金/足够时间
Avoid 时间充分 (false friend)

cecr-b21-nuances-m3.introTitleEn: 算是/算了/算上 and 就这样/就行/就好
cecr-b21-nuances-m3.introContentEn:
算 (suàn) has 3 lives: 算是不错的开始 (suànshì búcuò de kāishǐ) (counts as a decent start) ≠ 算了，我自己来 (suànle, wǒ zìjǐ lái) (forget it, I'll do it myself) ≠ 算上 (suàn shàng) (to include, count in).

- WARNING: 算了吧 (suànle ba) toward a superior sounds dismissive.

就好 (jiù hǎo) < 就行 (jiù xíng) < 就这样 (jiù zhèyàng) (final, sometimes curt).

- Add 吧 (ba) to soften: 就这样吧 (jiù zhèyàng ba) = OK that's fine.
- Without 吧 (ba), it sounds abrupt — an essential particle.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 算是/算了/算上
Avoid 算了吧 toward a superior
Choose 就好 vs 就行 vs 就这样
Always soften with 吧

cecr-b21-nuances-m4.introTitleEn: 只/只是/仅仅 and 不但/不仅/不仅仅
cecr-b21-nuances-m4.introContentEn:
只 (zhǐ) (neutral, spoken and written) < 只是 (zhǐshì) < 仅仅 (jǐnjǐn). 我只是问问 (wǒ zhǐshì wèn wèn) = a magic spoken B2.1 sentence that DEFUSES the pressure of a question.

- Mistake: 仅仅 (jǐnjǐn) in spontaneous speech sounds pedantic.

On the 'not only' side: 不只 (bùzhǐ) < 不但 (búdàn) (neutral, the most universal) < 不仅 (bùjǐn) (written B2.1+) < 不仅仅 (bùjǐnjǐn). Intensive formal combo: 这不仅仅是 X 的问题 (zhè bùjǐnjǐn shì X de wèntí) — a punchy rhetorical formula in a debate or editorial.
objectivesEn: Rank 只 → 只是 → 仅仅
Reserve 仅仅 for writing
Use 我只是问问 to soften
Master 不仅仅是 X 的问题 in a debate

cecr-b21-nuances-m5.introTitleEn: 居然/偏偏/难怪: surprise, bad luck, obviousness
cecr-b21-nuances-m5.introContentEn:
Three adverbs to express surprise and fate — very frequent in speech.

**居然 ≈ 竟然 = 'really?!' (negative or positive surprise)**

- 他居然忘了 (tā jūrán wàng le) = he actually dared to forget.
- 居然 sounds more spoken; 竟然 sounds slightly more written.

**偏偏 = 'of all things' (bad luck, mishap)**

- 偏偏今天下雨 (piānpiān jīntiān xià yǔ) = it had to rain of all days, today.

**难怪 + 原来 = revelation**

- 难怪你不来，原来你病了 (nánguài nǐ bù lái, yuánlái nǐ bìng le) = no wonder you didn't come, you were sick.

**难免 = 'inevitable'** — a comforting formula: 学语言难免会犯错 (xué yǔyán nánmiǎn huì fàncuò) = learning a language necessarily involves mistakes.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 居然/竟然 (surprise) vs 偏偏 (bad luck)
Comfort with 学 X 难免会 Y
Mark a revelation with 难怪 + 原来
Use 必然 in a formal argument

cecr-b21-nuances-m6.introTitleEn: 何况/况且/再说 and 此外/另外: piling on
cecr-b21-nuances-m6.introContentEn:
再说 (zàishuō) (spoken, 'besides') < 况且 (kuàngqiě) (formal written, 'moreover') < 何况 (hékuàng). 何况 (hékuàng) + a rhetorical question = a very powerful formula: '大学生都做不到，何况小学生 (dàxuéshēng dōu zuò bù dào, hékuàng xiǎoxuéshēng)?' 另外 (lìngwài) (besides, versatile spoken/written) ≠ 此外 (cǐwài). In B2.1+ writing, 此外 (cǐwài) is the no.1 tool to CHAIN arguments.

- CULTURALLY expected classic combo in a Chinese essay: 首先 X，其次 Y，此外 Z，最后 W (shǒuxiān X, qícì Y, cǐwài Z, zuìhòu W).
objectivesEn: Rank 再说 → 况且 → 何况
Use 何况 + rhetorical question
Tell apart 另外 vs 此外 by register
Structure an essay with 首先/其次/此外/最后

cecr-b21-nuances-m7.introTitleEn: 反而/却 and 越来越/越…越: reversal and progression
cecr-b21-nuances-m7.introContentEn:
反而 (fǎn'ér) (on the contrary, neutral/spoken standard — REVERSES the expectation: 我以为他生气，他反而笑了) ≈ 反倒 (fǎndào) ≠ 却 (què).

- 越来越 (yuè lái yuè) + adj = ONE variable progresses (天气越来越冷 (tiānqì yuè lái yuè lěng)).
- 越 (yuè) X 越 (yuè) Y = TWO variables increase together (越说越生气).
- Classic mistake: mixing the two structures.
- Formal variants: 日益 (rìyì) (day by day, written) / the chengyu 与日俱增 (yǔrì-jùzēng).
- Philosophical sentence: '越是简单的事情越是难做好 (yuè shì jiǎndān de shìqing yuè shì nán zuò hǎo)' — quote it to show your reflection.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 反而/反倒 (surprise) vs 却 (contrast)
Build 越来越 (1 variable)
Build 越 X 越 Y (2 variables)
Quote 越是简单越难做好 for depth

cecr-b22-grammar-complement-m1.introTitleEn: 完/好/懂/到: essential result complements
cecr-b22-grammar-complement-m1.introContentEn:
A verb alone is ambiguous: 吃 (chī) means 'eat' but doesn't say if it's finished. **Result complements** (V + result) fill this gap.

**The 4 essentials:**

- **完** (wán) = to finish: 吃完 (chī wán), 做完 (zuò wán).
- **好** (hǎo) = well-done / ready: 准备好 (zhǔnbèi hǎo), 写好 (xiě hǎo).
- **懂** (dǒng) = to understand: 听懂 (tīng dǒng), 看懂 (kàn dǒng).
