cecr-c21-wenyan-intro-m4.introContentEn: The 《论语》(Analects) open with: 子曰：「学而时习之，不亦说乎? 有朋自远方来，不亦乐乎? 人不知而不愠，不亦君子乎?」 (zǐ yuē: 'xué ér shí xí zhī, bù yì yuè hū? yǒu péng zì yuǎnfāng lái, bù yì lè hū? rén bù zhī ér bù yùn, bù yì jūnzǐ hū?') ('The Master said: To learn and review it in due time, is that not a joy? To have a friend come from afar, is that not a delight? To be unrecognized by others and not resent it, is that not to be a person of virtue?'). Key vocabulary: 子 (zǐ, the Master), 曰 (yuē, 'to say' in 文言), 时习 (shí xí), 朋 (péng), 愠 (yùn, to be inwardly annoyed), 君子 (jūnzǐ). This passage is memorized by every Chinese schoolchild. It illustrates the finals 乎 (hū) / 之 (zhī) studied earlier.
objectivesEn: Read the 1st paragraph of the 论语
Identify 子曰/君子/朋
Spot the triple 乎 question
Memorize this opening

cecr-c21-philo-classique-m1.introTitleEn: 孔子: the master who structured 2,500 years
cecr-c21-philo-classique-m1.introContentEn:
孔子 (Kǒngzǐ, Confucius, -551 → -479) is the founder of 儒家 (rújiā). Cardinal values: 仁 (rén), 义 (yì), 礼 (lǐ), 智 (zhì), 信 (xìn). The five are the 五常 (wǔcháng, 5 constant virtues). Social relations = 五伦 (wǔlún): ruler-subject, father-son, husband-wife, elder-younger, friend-friend. Each role has duties.

- 孝 (xiào, filial piety) remains fundamental.
- Text: 《论语》 gathers Confucius's sayings.
- Major heir: 孟子 (Mèngzǐ, Mencius, -372 → -289).

Today, Confucianism is officially rehabilitated in China.
objectivesEn: Know 孔子 and his dates
List 仁义礼智信 (五常)
Name the 五伦
Tell apart 孔子 vs 孟子

cecr-c21-philo-classique-m2.introContentEn:
道家 (dàojiā) was founded by 老子 (Lǎozǐ) in the 《道德经》(Dàodéjīng, Book of the Way and Virtue) — an 81-chapter text that opens with: 道可道，非常道 (dào kě dào, fēicháng dào) ('the Way that can be named is not the eternal Way').

- Central concept: 道 (dào, the Way, the undifferentiated principle).
- Another major concept: 无为 (wúwéi, non-action — acting in accordance with nature without forcing).

庄子 (Zhuāngzǐ) develops Taoism through parables. Contrast 儒 (rú) vs 道 (dào): social order vs natural spontaneity — two complementary poles of the Chinese soul.
objectivesEn: Read 道可道非常道
Understand 无为
Tell apart 老子 vs 庄子
Oppose 儒/道 complementarily

cecr-c21-philo-classique-m3.introTitleEn: 法家: governing by law, not virtue
cecr-c21-philo-classique-m3.introContentEn:
法家 (fǎjiā) opposes Confucianism: people are naturally bad, so govern by law (法 fǎ), political strategy and the position of power.

- Theorists: 商鞅 (Shāng Yāng, 4th c. BC, reformed the state of Qin), 韩非 (Hán Fēi, 3rd c. BC, the definitive synthesis in 《韩非子》).

Historical application: the Qin who unified China in -221 rigorously applied Legalism — formidable military efficiency, but a dynasty that lasted only 15 years. Since then, China oscillates around 儒表法里 (rú biǎo fǎ lǐ) ('Confucian on the surface, Legalist inside'). Legalism remains relevant to understanding contemporary governance.
objectivesEn: Define 法家 by 法/术/势
Cite 商鞅 and 韩非
Link Legalism to the Qin -221
Explain 儒表法里

cecr-c21-philo-classique-m4.introTitleEn: 佛: the Way that came from India
cecr-c21-philo-classique-m4.introContentEn: 佛教 (fójiào) entered China via the Silk Road in the 1st century AD. Progressive sinicization: Chan 禅 (chán) arose from the meeting of 佛 (fó) + 道 (dào). Key concepts: 佛 (fó, the Buddha — 'the Awakened One'), 菩萨 (púsà), 轮回 (lúnhuí), 业 (yè), 因果 (yīnguǒ). Practice: 念佛 (niànfó, reciting the Buddha's name), 烧香 (shāoxiāng), 磕头 (kētóu). Sites: 少林寺 (Shàolínsì), 白马寺 (Báimǎsì, White Horse Temple — the first). Three schools: 净土 (Jìngtǔ, Pure Land — the most popular), 禅宗 (Chánzōng), 密宗 (Mìzōng). Today it coexists with 道教 (dàojiào) and a fast-growing Christianity.
objectivesEn: Date the arrival of 佛教 (1st c.)
Define 佛/菩萨/轮回/业
Tell apart 净土/禅宗/密宗
Link 禅 to Japanese Zen

cecr-c21-poetry-m1.introTitleEn: The invisible grammar of Chinese poetry
cecr-c21-poetry-m1.introContentEn:
Classical poetry plays out through a few codified forms.

- 绝句 (juéjù): 4 lines, each of 5 or 7 characters.

律诗 (lǜshī): 8 lines, 5 or 7 characters, with strict constraints of tone and antithesis between lines 3-4 and 5-6. 词 (cí) ('word', a genre born under the Tang and flourishing under the Song) follows a melody (cípái) with the number of characters and tones fixed by the melody. To rhyme in Classical Chinese: it's the tones at line-ends that rhyme, generally on the even lines. Reading a poem = understanding nothing on the 1st read, then everything on the 5th thanks to the images.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 绝句 vs 律诗
Know 5字 and 7字
Understand 平/仄 rhyming
Present 词 and 词牌

cecr-c21-poetry-m2.introTitleEn: 李白 (701-762): 诗仙 — the Immortal of poetry
cecr-c21-poetry-m2.introContentEn:
李白 (Lǐ Bái) is the iconic figure of Chinese poetry, nicknamed 诗仙 (shīxiān, Immortal of poetry), fascinated by wine and travel. The most famous quatrain in all of Chinese literature: 《静夜思》(Jìngyè sī, 'Thoughts on a Quiet Night') — 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。举头望明月，低头思故乡。 (chuáng qián míng yuèguāng, yí shì dì shàng shuāng. jǔ tóu wàng míng yuè, dītóu sī gùxiāng.) ('Before my bed the bright moonlight / I first think it's frost on the ground. / I raise my head and gaze at the bright moon / I lower my head and think of my homeland.') Every Chinese schoolchild knows it.

- Themes: the moon 月 (yuè), wine 酒 (jiǔ), homesickness 思乡 (sīxiāng), travel.
- Style: free, imagistic, musical, cosmic.

A contrast with Du Fu, graver and more political.
objectivesEn: Know 李白 (701-762)
Recite 《静夜思》
Identify themes: moon/wine/nostalgia
Oppose 诗仙 vs 诗圣

cecr-c21-poetry-m3.introContentEn:
杜甫 (Dù Fǔ), a contemporary and friend of Li Bai, but an opposite spirit: grave, political, rooted in historical suffering. Nicknamed 诗圣 (shīshèng, Sage of poetry). He lived through the An Lushan rebellion (755-763) that shook the Tang dynasty, and made it one of the great subjects of his work. His most quoted line: 国破山河在 (guó pò shān hé zài) ('The nation is shattered, mountains and rivers remain') in 《春望》(Chūn Wàng).

- Style: rigorous, constrained, full of historical resonance.
- Themes: war, poverty, solidarity.

This 李白-杜甫 contrast structures the Chinese poetic consciousness: heaven (Li) and earth (Du), the wandering genius and the moral conscience.
objectivesEn: Know 杜甫 (712-770)
Cite 国破山河在
Place the An Lushan rebellion
Oppose grave 杜 to free 李

cecr-c21-poetry-m4.introContentEn: 李清照 (Lǐ Qīngzhào) is the greatest female voice in Chinese poetry, a master of 词 (cí). Raised in a scholarly family, she writes with an unprecedented sensitivity — marital joys, then mourning and exile after the Jurchen invasion (1127). Her most-quoted 词 (cí): 《声声慢》(Shēngshēng Màn) opens with 寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚 (xún xún mì mì, lěng lěng qīng qīng, qī qī cǎn cǎn qī qī) ('I search and search, cold and desolation, sad, sad, heartbreaking…') — 14 reduplicated characters that build an unmatched climate of distress. She is called 千古第一才女 (qiāngǔ dì yī cáinǚ) ('the foremost woman of genius through the ages'). She proves that Classical Chinese literature, despite the Confucian society, made room for exceptional female voices.
objectivesEn: Recite the opening of 声声慢
Understand 千古第一才女
Place the Jurchen invasion (1127)

cecr-c21-conversation-m1.introTitleEn: 拙见 + 斧正 — maximum humility in academia
cecr-c21-conversation-m1.introContentEn:
To root a point in tradition, you must build a bridge between past and present — a signal of intellectual maturity.

- Conference: 各位学者，今天我想就 X 这一议题展开论述 (gèwèi xuézhě, jīntiān wǒ xiǎng jiù X zhè yī yìtí zhǎnkāi lùnshù).
- Philosophical vocab: 论述 (lùnshù), 阐释 (chǎnshì), 释义 (shìyì), 注疏 (zhùshū).
- Quotation: 朱熹《四书章句集注》中说 X (Zhū Xī 《Sìshū Zhāngjù Jízhù》 zhōng shuō X).
- Conclude: 此乃笔者之拙见，敬请各位斧正 (cǐ nǎi bǐzhě zhī zhuōjiàn, jìngqǐng gèwèi fǔzhèng).
- Cite a classic: 《论语》有云：'X' (《Lúnyǔ》 yǒu yún: 'X').
- Verbs: 云 (yún), 曰 (yuē), 据载 (jùzài).
- To root it: 这句古训放在今天依然有现实意义 (zhè jù gǔxùn fàng zài jīntiān yīrán yǒu xiànshí yìyì) (the past ↔ present bridge = a signal of intellectual maturity).
objectivesEn: Open a conference with 论述 + 各位学者
Conclude with 拙见 + 斧正
Cite a classic with 云/曰/据载
Root a quotation in the present

cecr-c21-conversation-m2.introTitleEn: 见仁见智 — closing elegantly + placing a work in a school
cecr-c21-conversation-m2.introContentEn:
To show literary culture, you must be able to place a work in its school and era.

- Critical debate: 文学价值 (wénxué jiàzhí), 艺术成就 (yìshù chéngjiù), 主题深度 (zhǔtí shēndù), 笔触 (bǐchù).
- Elegant disagreement: 我对您的看法有些不同，我认为 X 反而是 Y (wǒ duì nín de kànfǎ yǒuxiē bùtóng, wǒ rènwéi X fǎn'ér shì Y).
- Elevated combo: 诚然 X，然而 Y (chéngrán X, rán'ér Y).
- Conclude: 文学评论本就见仁见智 (wénxué pínglùn běn jiù jiànrén-jiànzhì) (a CLOSING chengyu — neither you nor I are wrong).
- Recommend: 这部作品属于 X 流派 (zhè bù zuòpǐn shǔyú X liúpài).
- Schools: 朦胧诗派 (ménglóng shīpài), 寻根派 (xúngēnpài), 先锋派 (xiānfēngpài).
- C2 authors: 莫言 (Mò Yán) (Nobel 2012), 余华 (Yú Huá), 阎连科 (Yán Liánkē), 王小波 (Wáng Xiǎobō).
- Justify: 这部作品的价值在于 X (zhè bù zuòpǐn de jiàzhí zàiyú X).

To show your culture: PLACE the work in its school ('余华属于先锋派，但70年代后转向了人文写实').
objectivesEn: Elegant disagreement with 我倒认为
Close with 见仁见智
Place a work in its 流派
Name 莫言/余华/阎连科/王小波

cecr-c21-conversation-m3.introTitleEn: 信达雅 + 传神 — theory and practice of translation
cecr-c21-conversation-m3.introContentEn:
Translation is a re-creation: 翻译本就是一种再创作 (fānyì běn jiùshì yī zhǒng zài chuàngzuò). Yan Fu's classic theory sets: 信达雅 (xìn dá yǎ).

- Translation: 直译 (zhíyì) vs 意译 (yìyì).
- 我倾向于意译，因为直译会损失 X 的意境 (wǒ qīngxiàng yú yìyì, yīnwèi zhíyì huì sǔnshī X de yìjìng).
- 意境 (yìjìng) = an UNTRANSLATABLE keyword.
- Classical poem: 五言 (wǔyán)/七言 (qīyán), 平仄 (píngzè), 对仗 (duìzhàng).
- 5-step method: read aloud → count → rhymes → images → render.
- Adage: 译诗须传神，不必拘泥于字面 (yì shī xū chuánshén, búbì jūnì yú zìmiàn) (convey the spirit > the letter).
- 传神 (chuánshén) = a keyword.
objectivesEn: Cite 信达雅 (Yan Fu's theory)
Defend 意译 through 意境
Identify 五言/七言, 对仗
Invoke 译诗须传神，不必拘泥于字面

cecr-c21-conversation-m4.introTitleEn: 中庸之道 + 批判地继承 — applied wisdom
cecr-c21-conversation-m4.introContentEn:
In Confucian ethics, the wise person ADVISES without deciding for the other: 但最终的选择还是在您自己 (dàn zuìzhōng de xuǎnzé háishi zài nín zìjǐ).

- Ethical advisor: 道 (dào), 德 (dé), 仁 (rén), 义 (yì), 中庸 (zhōngyōng).
- 在我看来，您面临的是一个 X 的问题 (zài wǒ kànlái, nín miànlín de shì yī gè X de wèntí).
- Cite: 孔子曰 X (Kǒngzǐ yuē X) / 老子说 X (Lǎozǐ shuō X).
- Recommendation: 我建议您从 X 的角度看 (wǒ jiànyì nín cóng X de jiǎodù kàn).
- 中庸 (zhōngyōng): 也许中庸之道才是答案 (yěxǔ zhōngyōng zhī dào cái shì dá'àn) (perhaps the middle way is the answer).

Modern Confucianism debate: pro (思想至今仍有现实意义 — 仁, 礼, 学而时习之) vs critique (no longer adapts). Synthesis: 我认为可以批判地继承传统 (wǒ rènwéi kěyǐ pīpàn de jìchéng chuántǒng) (a Maoist formula turned all-purpose).
objectivesEn: Advise via 道 / 德 / 仁 / 义 / 中庸
Respect autonomy: 选择在您自己
Invoke 中庸之道
Synthesize via 批判地继承

cecr-c21-conversation-m5.introTitleEn: 灵感 + 构思 — talking about your work with modesty
cecr-c21-conversation-m5.introContentEn:
In an interview or reading circle, modesty is MANDATORY: never explicitly self-promote.

- Author interview: 这次的写作灵感来自 X (zhè cì de xiězuò línggǎn láizì X).
- Process: 我前后修改了 X 次 (wǒ qiánhòu xiūgǎi le X cì), 我用了 X 年完成 (wǒ yòng le X nián wánchéng).
- Meaning: 我想表达的核心思想是 X (wǒ xiǎng biǎodá de héxīn sīxiǎng shì X).
- Projects: 目前正在构思下一部作品 (mùqián zhèngzài gòusī xià yī bù zuòpǐn) (an elevated 'conceiving').
- Modesty: 希望读者能从中获得一些启示 (xīwàng dúzhě néng cóngzhōng huòdé yìxiē qǐshì).
- Reading circle: 各位书友，大家好 (gèwèi shūyǒu, dàjiā hǎo) (a warm 'book friend').
- Kick off: 这本书最让您印象深刻的是什么 (zhè běn shū zuì ràng nín yìnxiàng shēnkè de shì shénme)?
- Conclude: 谢谢大家的精彩分享 (xièxie dàjiā de jīngcǎi fēnxiǎng).

RULE: address participants by name ('张老师，您怎么看?') — otherwise, out of Chinese modesty, few dare speak.
objectivesEn: Talk about a work via 灵感 + 构思
Author modesty: 获得一些启示
Host a 书友会 (circle)
Address participants by name

cecr-c21-conversation-m6.introTitleEn: 比喻/排比/反问 + 缅怀 (memory of the departed)
cecr-c21-conversation-m6.introContentEn:
C2 figures of speech: 比喻 (bǐyù), 夸张 (kuāzhāng), 对偶 (duì'ǒu), 排比 (páibǐ), 反问 (fǎnwèn). In a eulogy, the hierarchy is: LIFE 50% > mourning 30% > legacy 20% (reversing = perceived as depressing).

- Punchy combo: 排比 (páibǐ) + 反问 (fǎnwèn) ('我们要勇敢，要坚定，要前行。难道不是吗?').
- Oratorical conclusion: 时不我待 (shí bù wǒ dài) (a chengyu — time waits for no one).
- Eulogy: 悼念 (dàoniàn), 追忆 (zhuīyì), 缅怀 (miǎnhuái).
- MANDATORY opening: 今天，我们怀着沉痛的心情悼念 X (jīntiān, wǒmen huái zhe chéntòng de xīnqíng dàoniàn X).
- Evoke: X 一生致力于 Y (X yīshēng zhìlìyú Y).
- Inspire: X 的精神将激励我们继续前行 (X de jīngshén jiāng jīlì wǒmen jìxù qiánxíng).
- Conclude: 安息吧，我们永远怀念您 (ānxī ba, wǒmen yǒngyuǎn huáiniàn nín).
objectivesEn: Oratorical combo 排比 + 反问
Close with 时不我待
Eulogy with 沉痛 + 缅怀 + 安息
Respect the life/mourning/legacy hierarchy

cecr-c21-conversation-m7.introTitleEn: 据笔者所知 + 略显薄弱 — humility + measured critique
cecr-c21-conversation-m7.introContentEn:
In academic reviews, always use '略显 X (lüè xiǎn X)' (a bit X) rather than '完全 X (wánquán X)' — restraint that saves face and allows revision without hostility.

- Essay: 引言 (yǐnyán) → 文献综述 (wénxiàn zōngshù) → 论点 (lùndiǎn) → 论证 (lùnzhèng) → 反驳异议 (fǎnbó yìyì) → 结论 (jiélùn) → 参考文献 (cānkǎo wénxiàn).
- Opening: 自古以来，X 一直是一个重要的话题 (zìgǔ yǐlái, X yīzhí shì yī gè zhòngyào de huàtí) / 据笔者所知 (jù bǐzhě suǒ zhī).
- Thesis: 本文的核心论点是 X (běn wén de héxīn lùndiǎn shì X).
- Conclude: 综上所述，这一发现对 Y 具有重要意义 (zōng shàng suǒshù, zhè yī fāxiàn duì Y jùyǒu zhòngyào yìyì).
- NEVER '我 (wǒ)' → 笔者 (bǐzhě) or '本研究 (běn yánjiū)'.
- Peer review: 同行评议 (tóngháng píngyì).
- Categories: 录用 (lùyòng) / 修改后录用 (xiūgǎi hòu lùyòng) / 拒稿 (jùgǎo).
- Positives: 本文选题新颖 (běn wén xuǎntí xīnyǐng), 论证严密 (lùnzhèng yánmì), 文献丰富 (wénxiàn fēngfù).
objectivesEn: Ban 我 → 笔者/本研究
Master 据笔者所知
Tell apart 录用/修改后录用/拒稿
Critique with 略显 X (measured)

cecr-c21-nuances-m1.introTitleEn: The fundamental triad + the 5 cardinal virtues
cecr-c21-nuances-m1.introContentEn:
道 (dào) → 德 (dé) → 礼 (lǐ). Without 德 (dé), 礼 (lǐ) is empty; without 礼 (lǐ), 德 (dé) is invisible. An INSEPARABLE triad. 仁 (rén, the basis of all) / 义 (yì) / 礼 (lǐ) / 智 (zhì) / 信 (xìn) = the 五常 (wǔcháng, 5 cardinal virtues). '见义勇为 (jiànyì-yǒngwéi)' is socially honored.

- If a Chinese person says '这个人没有德 (zhège rén méiyǒu dé)', they mean morally hollow; '没有礼 (méiyǒu lǐ)' = ill-mannered.

A CRITICAL distinction for nuancing a social judgment.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 道 (principle) / 德 (virtue) / 礼 (rite)
Name the 五常 (仁义礼智信)
Invoke 见义勇为 to praise
Tell apart 没有德 vs 没有礼

cecr-c21-nuances-m2.introContentEn: 阴 (yīn, feminine/dark/cold/moon) ≠ 阳 (yáng, masculine/bright/hot/sun). These two forces are in constant flux. The cosmology of the 五行 (wǔxíng): 木→火→土→金→水 (mù→huǒ→tǔ→jīn→shuǐ) with cycles 相生 (xiāngshēng) / 相克 (xiāngkè) structures medicine, feng shui and the calendar. '阴阳平衡 (yīnyáng pínghéng)' = a central wellbeing formula. Classical poetry: 诗 (shī) → 词 (cí) (Song, to a melody — 苏轼, 李清照) → 曲 (qǔ, Yuan — 关汉卿). Mnemonic: the chronological order of the dynasties. '李清照写的词 (Lǐ Qīngzhào xiě de cí)' is correct; '李清照的诗 (Lǐ Qīngzhào de shī)' is technically wrong.
objectivesEn: Master 阴阳 + 五行 (cycles)
Invoke 阴阳平衡
Tell apart 诗 (Tang) / 词 (Song) / 曲 (Yuan)
Match each form to its authors

cecr-c21-nuances-m3.introContentEn:
中庸 (zhōngyōng) ≠ 中立 (zhōnglì) ≠ 中间 (zhōngjiān). '中庸之道 (zhōngyōng zhī dào)' = a Chinese intellectual compliment. 中庸 (zhōngyōng) IMPLIES an active judgment; 中立 (zhōnglì) is ABSTENTION — confusing the two is a philosophical error.

- Confusing 中庸 (zhōngyōng) and 中立 (zhōnglì) = a philosophical error.

天下 (tiānxià) ('all-under-heaven', the imperial vision, '天下兴亡，匹夫有责' — Gu Yanwu) ≠ 国家 (guójiā) ≠ 民族 (mínzú). This distinction structures every debate on Chinese identity.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 中庸 (virtue) / 中立 (political) / 中间 (space)
Invoke 中庸之道
Tell apart 天下 / 国家 / 民族
Cite 天下兴亡，匹夫有责

cecr-c21-nuances-m4.introContentEn:
言 (yán, 名言, 言之有理) / 而 (ér, and/but — 学而时习之, alive in 而且, 然而) / 于 (yú, at/in — 出于, 关于, 至于, 由于). Quoting '学而时习之，不亦说乎' = an IMMEDIATE signal of scholarly level. Axes of judgment: 是非 (shìfēi, true/false) ≠ 善恶 (shàn'è, MORAL good/evil — 善有善报，恶有恶报) ≠ 对错 (duìcuò, right/wrong).

- Confusing 是非 (shìfēi) and 善恶 (shàn'è) = a classic error (a fact can be 是 but 恶).
objectivesEn: Recognize 言/而/于 in the classical
Cite 学而时习之，不亦说乎
Tell apart 是非 (true) / 善恶 (good) / 对错 (right)
Recite 善有善报，恶有恶报

cecr-c21-nuances-m5.introContentEn:
身 (shēn, body) < 心 (xīn, heart-mind, NOT separated in Chinese — 心情, 心思, 关心) < 灵 (líng, soul) < 神 (shén, spirit, 神圣). '身心灵 (shēnxīnlíng)' is a trendy modern-wellness trilogy ('我们要追求身心灵的平衡'). Cosmos: 天 (tiān, heaven) / 地 (dì, earth) / 人 (rén, the human cosmological MEDIATOR). 三才 (sāncái, the 3 powers) = 天地人 (tiāndìrén). '天时地利人和 (tiānshí dìlì rénhé)' (a chengyu: the 3 conditions of success — the timing of heaven, the advantage of earth, human harmony).

- To praise a success: '这是天时地利人和的结果 (zhè shì tiānshí dìlì rénhé de jiéguǒ)'.
objectivesEn: Rank 身 → 心 → 灵 → 神
Master the trilogy 身心灵
Understand 三才 (天地人)
Invoke 天时地利人和

cecr-c21-nuances-m6.introContentEn:
氛围 (fēnwéi, atmosphere) < 风格 (fēnggé, artistic style — 这位画家的风格) < 意境 (yìjìng, an UNTRANSLATABLE poetic atmosphere, a fusion of image + setting, a central concept of Chinese aesthetics).

- The ULTIMATE compliment for a Chinese work: '这很有意境 (zhè hěn yǒu yìjìng)' (more powerful than 很美).

Character: 性格 (xìnggé) < 人格 (réngé, 人格尊严) < 品格 (pǐngé).

- Mistake: 性格高尚 (xìnggé gāoshàng) ✗ → 品格高尚 (pǐngé gāoshàng) ✓.
- To praise an elder: '您的品格让我深受感动 (nín de pǐngé ràng wǒ shēn shòu gǎndòng)'.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 氛围 / 风格 / 意境
Compliment a Chinese work with 意境
Tell apart 性格 / 人格 / 品格
Compliment an elder with 品格

cecr-c21-nuances-m7.introContentEn:
知 (zhī, to know) < 识 (shí, discernment — 见识 / 识别) < 智 (zhì, wisdom). Compliment: '您是有智慧的人 (nín shì yǒu zhìhuì de rén)' > '您知识丰富 (nín zhīshi fēngfù)' (wise > learned). '增长见识 (zēngzhǎng jiànshi)' (to broaden one's experience) = a culturally valued goal. Level: 水平 (shuǐpíng, a concrete measurable level — 学习水平) < 层次 (céngcì, an intellectual structure — 高层次的人) < 境界 (jìngjiè, a spiritual-philosophical level — a deep concept). Wang Guowei posed the '三种境界 (sān zhǒng jìngjiè)' of creation: (1) 独上高楼，望尽天涯路; (2) 衣带渐宽终不悔; (3) 蓦然回首，那人却在灯火阑珊处.

- Quoting them = a scholarly C2 signal.
objectivesEn: Rank 知 → 识 → 智
Compliment with 智慧 > 知识
Rank 水平 → 层次 → 境界
Mention Wang Guowei's 三种境界

cecr-c22-rhetoric-m1.introTitleEn: 对偶 (duì'ǒu): the rhetoric of balance
cecr-c22-rhetoric-m1.introContentEn: 对偶 (duì'ǒu) is the fundamental rhetorical device of classical and elevated Chinese. Two clauses of equal length (often 4 or 7 characters) mirror each other: the same number of syllables, the same syntactic structure, words of the same grammatical class, opposite tones. Ex.: 山重水复疑无路，柳暗花明又一村 (shān zhòng shuǐ fù yí wú lù, liǔ àn huā míng yòu yī cūn) ('Mountains piled, waters folded — I think there's no road left / Willows dark, flowers bright — another village'), by Lu You. Another: 海内存知己，天涯若比邻 (hǎinèi cún zhījǐ, tiānyá ruò bǐlín) ('As long as you have a friend within the four seas, the ends of the earth feel like a neighbor'), by Wang Bo. The New Year couplets 春联 (chūnlián) pasted on doors are 对偶 (duì'ǒu). An elevated news article or an official speech often contains several to mark the rhetoric.
objectivesEn: Define 对偶 (mirror structure)
Identify a parallelism in a text
Compose a simple 春联
Recognize it in a speech

cecr-c22-rhetoric-m2.introContentEn: 比喻 (bǐyù): explicit with 像 (xiàng)/如 (rú)/仿佛 (fǎngfú) ('like') — 她像花一样美 (tā xiàng huā yíyàng měi) ('beautiful as a flower'); implicit without a linking word — 她是花 (tā shì huā) ('she is a flower'). In 借喻 (jièyù), the tenor is directly replaced by the vehicle. 拟人 (nǐrén) lends human traits to the inanimate: 风唱着歌 (fēng chàng zhe gē) ('the wind sings'). 夸张 (kuāzhāng) amplifies to the extreme — 李白 (Lǐ Bái) excels: 白发三千丈 (báifà sānqiān zhàng) ('my white hair is a thousand zhang long'). C2 prose without these figures sounds flat; overusing them sounds kitschy.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 明喻 vs 暗喻 vs 借喻
Use 像/如/仿佛
Create a natural 拟人
Dose 夸张 without excess

cecr-c22-rhetoric-m3.introTitleEn: Adapting the register to the audience
cecr-c22-rhetoric-m3.introContentEn:
Chinese offers a very wide spectrum of registers. 大白话 (dà báihuà): 咱们 (zánmen, inclusive 'we'), 啥 (shá, = 什么), 瞧 (qiáo) — spoken, oral, a conversational tone. 标准普通话 (biāozhǔn pǔtōnghuà): the register of the news, the textbook, neutral. 书面语 (shūmiànyǔ): a written, elevated style, with 该 (gāi) for 这 (zhè), 之 (zhī) for 的 (de), long, structured sentences. 文言化 (wényánhuà): heavily tinged with the classical, for solemn speeches, academic articles, calligraphy. Register error: writing 咱们 (zánmen) in a company report or 之 (zhī) in a text message triggers unease.

- C2 mastery = knowing how to navigate the spectrum deliberately.
objectivesEn: Identify the 4 registers
Avoid register errors
Move from 大白话 to 书面语
Know solemn 文言化

cecr-c22-translation-m1.introTitleEn: The founding motto of Chinese translation studies
cecr-c22-translation-m1.introContentEn:
In 1898, the translator 严复 (Yán Fù) formulated the motto: 信达雅 (xìn dá yǎ) in his preface to a translation of T.H. Huxley. The 3 criteria are ranked by text (legal = 信 first, poetry = 雅 central).

- 信 (xìn): don't betray the meaning.
- 达 (dá): let the text flow naturally in the target language.
- 雅 (yǎ): choose an elevated register.
- Modern debates: Lu Xun prioritizes 信 (xìn) at the expense of 达 (dá) ('rather hard than distorted').

Nida (USA) conceptualizes 'dynamic equivalence'. Translation is never neutral: every choice is a compromise.
objectivesEn: Define 信/达/雅
Cite 严复 (1898)
Rank them by the text
Oppose Yan Fu to Lu Xun

cecr-c22-translation-m2.introTitleEn: The traps that ALWAYS trip you up
cecr-c22-translation-m2.introContentEn: Translation traps EN → Chinese: (1) Articles a/the don't exist in Chinese. (2) Plurals aren't marked except via 些 (xiē)/们 (men). (3) Grammatical tense rendered by aspect + a time adverb. (4) Relative pronouns (who, that, whose) = a pre-posed clause with 的 (de). (5) Deceptive polysemy: 厉害 (lìhai) = 'terrible' AND 'awesome' by context; English 'funny' = 好玩 (hǎowán) OR 可笑 (kěxiào). (6) Proper-name order: in Chinese you say COUNTRY + descriptor before the name: 中国著名作家鲁迅 (Zhōngguó zhùmíng zuòjiā Lǔ Xùn) ('the famous Chinese author Lu Xun'). (7) False friends: 爱人 (àiren) can mean 'spouse' (not 'lover'); 同志 (tóngzhì) = 'comrade' but also slang for 'homosexual'. (8) Proverbs: translating an English proverb LITERALLY into Chinese produces an absurdity.
objectivesEn: Avoid literal translation of articles
Render relatives with 的
Disambiguate 厉害/爱人/同志
Respect Chinese proper-name order

cecr-c22-translation-m3.introContentEn:
Some concepts exist only in the Chinese mental universe and often require an explanation rather than a direct translation. Sometimes, leaving the Chinese word in italics is the best choice.

- 缘分 (yuánfèn) ('predestined affinity' — a providential encounter, a Buddhist idea).
- 气 (qì) (vital energy — not just 'breath' but a life principle).
- 江湖 (jiānghú) (literally 'rivers and lakes' — the parallel world of wandering knights, codes of honor, martial arts; the modern sense extends to all marginal circles).
- 孝 (xiào) (filial piety — not reducible to 'respect for parents': a whole moral system).
- 面子 (miànzi) ('face'), 关系 (guānxì).
- 委屈 (wěiqu) (the feeling of an injustice endured without being able to complain).
- 吃苦 (chīkǔ) ('to eat bitterness' = to endure hardship) — a virtue-concept, not just 'to suffer'.
objectivesEn: Grasp 缘分 (affinity)
Tell apart spiritual 气 vs respiratory
Contextualize 江湖
Value 吃苦 as a virtue

cecr-c22-modern-lit-m1.introContentEn: Under Mao (1949-1976), literature is 服务工农兵 (fúwù gōng nóng bīng) ('in service of workers, peasants and soldiers'). Writers imprisoned or silenced. After 1978 came 伤痕文学 (shānghén wénxué) ('scar literature') recounting the Cultural Revolution: 刘心武 (Liú Xīnwǔ) 《班主任》(1977). Then 寻根文学 (xúngēn wénxué) ('root-seeking literature') returns to rural traditions: 韩少功 (Hán Shàogōng), 阿城 (Ā Chéng). The 80s: 余华 (Yú Huá) writes 《活着》(Huózhe, 'To Live!', 1993) — the story of a peasant who loses everything amid the upheavals of the 20th century, perhaps the most translated contemporary Chinese novel. Adapted by Zhang Yimou in 1994.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 伤痕 vs 寻根
Know 余华 and 《活着》
Place 服务工农兵
Link to Zhang Yimou's film

cecr-c22-modern-lit-m2.introContentEn: 莫言 (Mò Yán) (a pen name meaning 'Don't speak', born 1955) received the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2012 — the first PRC writer to win it. His landmark work: 《红高粱家族》(Hóng Gāoliáng Jiāzú, 'Red Sorghum Clan'), adapted for cinema by Zhang Yimou in 1988 (Golden Bear in Berlin). Style: 'hallucinatory realism' (per the Nobel Academy), a fusion of reality, folklore and the grotesque — kin to García Márquez but rooted in rural 山东 (Shāndōng). Other works: 《丰乳肥臀》(Big Breasts and Wide Hips, 1995), 《生死疲劳》(Life and Death Are Wearing Me Out, 2006). Internationally acclaimed, more contested in China (accused of leniency toward the regime).
objectivesEn: Know 莫言 (Nobel 2012)
Cite 《红高粱》 and the film
Define 'hallucinatory realism'
Place rural 山东

cecr-c22-modern-lit-m3.introTitleEn: 三体: Chinese sci-fi goes global
cecr-c22-modern-lit-m3.introContentEn:
刘慈欣 (Liú Cíxīn, Liu Cixin, born 1963), an engineer turned writer, publishes 《三体》(Sāntǐ, 'The Three-Body Problem', 2008), then 《黑暗森林》(2008) and 《死神永生》(2010), forming the trilogy 《地球往事》(Remembrance of Earth's Past). The first volume won the 2015 Hugo Award — a major event: a work of Chinese sci-fi becomes internationally iconic.

- Adaptations: Tencent series 2023, then Netflix 2024.

Concepts introduced into general vocabulary: 黑暗森林 (hēi'àn sēnlín) ('dark forest' — the hypothesis of a hostile cosmos where every visible civilization is destroyed), 三体文明 (sāntǐ wénmíng) (Trisolaris civilization). Chinese sci-fi then explodes: Hao Jingfang (Hugo 2016), Chen Qiufan, Xia Jia.
objectivesEn: Know 刘慈欣 and his trilogy
Understand 黑暗森林 (the hypothesis)
Cite Hugo 2015 and adaptations
Name other Chinese sci-fi writers

cecr-c22-dialects-m1.introTitleEn: 'Common language': how a dialect became the norm
cecr-c22-dialects-m1.introContentEn:
普通话 (pǔtōnghuà) (literally 'common speech') = standard Mandarin, based on Beijing pronunciation, the lexicon of northern dialects, and the grammar of modern vernacular works. Officially promoted in 1956 as the national language of the PRC. In Taiwan: 国语 (guóyǔ) ('national language') — the same base but a slightly different pronunciation.

- In Singapore/Malaysia: 华语 (huáyǔ) ('Sinophone language').
- Vocabulary differs: 自行车 (zìxíngchē)/脚踏车 (jiǎotàchē), 出租车 (chūzūchē)/计程车 (jìchéngchē)/的士 (díshì).

A 普通话 (pǔtōnghuà) speaker will understand 95% of 国语 (guóyǔ) and vice versa. Today, > 80% of the Chinese population speaks 普通话 (pǔtōnghuà), against ~50% in 1950.
objectivesEn: Define 普通话 (origin/base)
Tell apart 普通话/国语/华语
Spot lexical variations
Date the promotion (1956)

cecr-c22-dialects-m2.introContentEn: 粤语 (yuèyǔ) is not a Mandarin dialect but a distinct Chinese language, spoken in Canton, Hong Kong and Macau. 6 to 9 tones (vs 4 in Mandarin), it preserves the final consonants -p, -t, -k that disappeared from modern Mandarin but exist in 文言 (wényán). A Mandarin speaker does NOT understand spoken Cantonese without study. Examples: 'hello' = 你好 (nǐ hǎo) in Mandarin vs 你好 in Cantonese (nei5 hou2), 'thank you' = 谢谢 (xièxie) vs 唔该 (m4 goi1) — Cantonese preserves 唔 (m4). In Hong Kong: 繁体字 (fántǐzì, traditional characters) remains the norm, unlike the mainland. Hong Kong cinema (wǔxiá films) and Cantopop have spread Cantonese worldwide.
objectivesEn: Tell 粤语 apart from 普通话
Count the 6-9 Cantonese tones
Read 繁体字 vs simplified
Understand 唔该/多谢

cecr-c22-dialects-m3.introContentEn: China has 7-10 major Chinese languages, all written with the same characters but mutually unintelligible in speech: 官话 (guānhuà, Mandarin, > 70% of speakers), 粤语 (yuèyǔ, Cantonese, 70M), 吴语 (wúyǔ, Wu/Shanghainese, 80M), 闽南语 (Mǐnnányǔ, Southern Min, including Taiwanese 台语 and Fujian variants, 50M), 客家话 (kèjiāhuà, Hakka, 50M, diaspora), 湘 (xiāng), 赣 (gàn). Taiwan: 60% speak 台语 (táiyǔ) in addition to 国语 (guóyǔ), an identity language after decades of KMT bans. Every big city keeps its own speech: 北京话 (Běijīnghuà) ≠ 普通话 (pǔtōnghuà) (Beijing dialect has distinctive expressions: 您内 for an emphatic 您). Media standardization weakens the dialects — a cultural preservation issue.
objectivesEn: Map the 7 Chinese languages
Place 吴语 (Shanghai)
Understand 闽南/台语 in Taiwan
Explain dialect preservation

cecr-c22-global-china-m1.introTitleEn: From 韬光养晦 to 大国外交
cecr-c22-global-china-m1.introContentEn:
Deng Xiaoping stated: 韬光养晦 (tāoguāng yǎnghuì) ('hide your light, nurture the dark' = keep a low profile, quietly build strength). Since Xi Jinping (2013), the doctrine is 大国外交 (dàguó wàijiāo, great-power diplomacy) and 人类命运共同体 (rénlèi mìngyùn gòngtóngtǐ, 'a community of shared destiny for humanity'). The flagship initiative: 一带一路 (Yídài Yílù, BRI/New Silk Roads) — 150+ signatory countries, focused on infrastructure, a 陆上 (lùshàng, land) + 海上 (hǎishàng, sea) corridor.

- Criticisms: 'debt trap', environmental conditions.

Other terms: 战狼外交 (zhànláng wàijiāo, 'Wolf Warrior diplomacy', assertive, named after a film), 一个中国 (yī gè Zhōngguó, 'One China').
objectivesEn: Oppose 韬光养晦 to 大国外交
Explain 一带一路 (figures)
Define 战狼外交
Understand 命运共同体

cecr-c22-global-china-m2.introContentEn: Essential distinctions: 华侨 (huáqiáo, an overseas Chinese citizen), 华人 (huárén, an ethnic Chinese person), 华裔 (huáyì, a descendant of Chinese heritage of another nationality, typically born abroad). Main hubs: 东南亚 (dōngnán yà, Southeast Asia — Singapore 75% Chinese, Malaysia 23%, Indonesia 4%+), 美国 (Měiguó, 5M+ with a Chinatown in every big city), 澳洲 (Àozhōu), 欧洲 (Ōuzhōu). Migration history: 19th-century coolies (California Gold Rush, Panama, railroads); the 1949 wave (fleeing the CCP, to Taiwan and Hong Kong); the post-1978 wave (students, white-collar workers). Cultural vocabulary: 唐人街 (tángrén jiē, 'street of the people of Tang' = Chinatown), 侨乡 (qiáoxiāng, regions of origin: Guangdong and Fujian mostly).
objectivesEn: Tell apart 华侨/华人/华裔
Name the diaspora hubs
Trace the 3 migration waves
Understand 唐人街/侨乡

cecr-c22-global-china-m3.introContentEn:
Soft power 软实力 (ruǎnshílì). Confucius Institutes — 500+ centers worldwide teaching language/culture (the Goethe-Institut model). Cinema: 《哪吒》(Nézhā, 2019), the first Chinese animated global blockbuster; 流浪地球 (The Wandering Earth, 2019) demonstrates sci-fi capability. 李子柒 (Lǐ Zǐqī): a hugely followed YouTuber, aestheticized rural life, organic cultural reach outside the official apparatus. Video games: 原神 (Yuánshén, Genshin Impact) is the first global hit of a Chinese game, with revenue comparable to Hollywood. TikTok/抖音 (Dǒuyīn): the Chinese global version (ByteDance), reshaping worldwide media consumption.

- Limits: censorship and diplomatic suspicions curb the impact.

中国文化 (Zhōngguó wénhuà) doesn't yet have Hollywood's universality, but is gaining ground.
objectivesEn: Define 软实力
Cite 孔子学院/哪吒/流浪地球
Know 李子柒 and 原神
Nuance the global impact

cecr-c22-conversation-m1.introTitleEn: 跟读 + 概括 + 预判 — the pro interpreter's triad
cecr-c22-conversation-m1.introContentEn:
For any technical term with no official translation, never invent without flagging it: 这个词目前没有标准译法，我建议译为 X (zhège cí mùqián méiyǒu biāozhǔn yìfǎ, wǒ jiànyì yì wèi X).

- Interpreting: 同声传译 (tóngshēng chuányì) / 交替传译 (jiāotì chuányì).
- Techniques: 跟读 (gēndú) (a 3-5 sec lag) / 概括 (gàikuò) / 预判 (yùpàn) (anticipate the end of the sentence).
- Chinese SVO tip: WAIT for the main verb, then render it all at once.
- Glossary: ALWAYS ask for the agenda + PowerPoint in advance.
- Sources: 联合国术语库 (Liánhéguó shùyǔkù), 中国译协 (Zhōngguó Yìxié).

Create a collaborative glossary on 飞书 (Fēishū) / 腾讯文档 (Téngxùn Wéndàng) with the other interpreters.
objectivesEn: Master 跟读 + 概括 + 预判
Anticipate the Chinese SVO verb
Prepare 100-200 术语 per assignment
Coordinate the glossary with colleagues

cecr-c22-conversation-m2.introTitleEn: 第五代/第六代 + 字幕组 culture
cecr-c22-conversation-m2.introContentEn:
Mentioning '第五代 (dì wǔ dài, the Fifth Generation)' in the first minute = an IMMEDIATE cinephile signal. The Chinese 字幕组 (zìmùzǔ, fansub) culture (Renren, Yanmo) shaped cosmopolitan viewers.

- Cinema: 导演 (dǎoyǎn), 编剧 (biānjù), 摄影 (shèyǐng), 镜头 (jìngtóu), 美学 (měixué).
- Major directors: 张艺谋 (Zhāng Yìmóu, 红高粱), 陈凯歌 (Chén Kǎigē), 王家卫 (Wáng Jiāwèi, 花样年华), 贾樟柯 (Jiǎ Zhāngkē).
- Subtitling: max 2 lines, 12-15 Chinese chars, 6 sec on screen.
- Techniques: COMPRESS, TRANSCREATE, PRESERVE the tone.
- For jokes: 直译会让观众一头雾水 (zhíyì huì ràng guānzhòng yìtóu wùshuǐ) — prefer 本地化 (běndìhuà, localization).
- Chengyu: 一头雾水 (yìtóu wùshuǐ) (lost, lit. 'head in the fog').
objectivesEn: Name 张艺谋/陈凯歌/王家卫/贾樟柯
Mention 第五代/第六代
Master subtitling constraints
Invoke 一头雾水

cecr-c22-conversation-m3.introTitleEn: 粤语 + 上海话 — living sub-languages
cecr-c22-conversation-m3.introContentEn:
In Hong Kong, saying 唔該 (m4 goi1) at every exchange = an IMMEDIATE signal that you know the codes. Recognizing a dialect by ear = a sign of a regional connoisseur.

- Cantonese 粤语 (yuèyǔ): 80M speakers (Guangdong + HK + diaspora). 9 tones. Traditional characters in HK.
- Specific characters: 嘅 (= 的), 嗰, 唔 — knowing them = reading 80% of HK Facebook.
- Shanghainese 上海话 (shànghǎihuà).
- Pronouns: 侬 (nóng) / 阿拉 (ā lā).
- Star word: 嗲 (diǎ).
- To praise: '阿拉上海好嗲 (ā lā shànghǎi hǎo diǎ)' (our Shanghai is so chic — addressed to a native Shanghainese).
objectivesEn: Greet in Cantonese with 唔該
Read 嘅/嗰/唔 (Cantonese chars)
Tell apart 侬 vs 你 (Shanghainese)
Invoke 嗲 in Shanghai

cecr-c22-conversation-m4.introTitleEn: 伤痕文学 → 网络文学 — 80 years in 7 waves
cecr-c22-conversation-m4.introContentEn:
To analyze contemporary Chinese literature: 网络文学已成为中国文学的重要部分，不容忽视 (wǎngluò wénxué yǐ chéngwéi Zhōngguó wénxué de zhòngyào bùfen, bùróng hūshì). For sensitive subjects like the Cultural Revolution, use 那个特殊的年代 (nàge tèshū de niándài, that special era).

- Waves: 伤痕 (shānghén) → 寻根 (xúngēn) → 先锋 (xiānfēng) → 新写实 (xīn xiěshí) → 网络 (wǎngluò).
- C2.2 authors: 莫言 (Mò Yán), 余华 (Yú Huá), 阎连科 (Yán Liánkē), 王安忆 (Wáng Ānyì), 韩少功 (Hán Shàogōng), 苏童 (Sū Tóng), 张悦然 (Zhāng Yuèrán), 残雪 (Cán Xuě).
- Phrase: 这部作品反映了一个时代的集体记忆 (zhè bù zuòpǐn fǎnyìng le yī gè shídài de jítǐ jìyì).
- Online literature 网络文学 (wǎngluò wénxué) (起点中文网): 玄幻 (xuánhuàn), 都市 (dūshì), 修仙 (xiūxiān), 穿越 (chuānyuè), 末世 (mòshì).
- Model: 1 chapter/day of 3,000 chars, micro-transactions.
- Star authors: 唐家三少 (Táng Jiā Sān Shǎo), 我吃西红柿 (Wǒ Chī Xīhóngshì).
objectivesEn: Name 5 post-1980 literary waves
Evoke 文革 with 那个特殊的年代
Know 5 genres of 网络文学
Invoke 不容忽视

cecr-c22-conversation-m5.introTitleEn: 导师 (dialogue) vs 师傅 (technical) + face-saving sandwich
cecr-c22-conversation-m5.introContentEn:
The modern mentor prefers 我陪你一起摸索 (wǒ péi nǐ yìqǐ mōsuǒ). 导师 (dǎoshī) ≠ 师傅 (shīfu). The magic question to encourage face-saving self-correction: '如果你重新做一次，会有什么不一样 (rúguǒ nǐ chóngxīn zuò yī cì, huì yǒu shénme bù yíyàng)?'

- Mentor: 我把你当作朋友，分享我的经验 (wǒ bǎ nǐ dàngzuò péngyou, fēnxiǎng wǒ de jīngyàn).
- Avoid '你应该 X (nǐ yīnggāi X)' → prefer '你可以考虑 X / 一种思路是 X (nǐ kěyǐ kǎolǜ X / yī zhǒng sīlù shì X)'.
- Mirror question: 你自己是怎么想的 (nǐ zìjǐ shì zěnme xiǎng de)?
- Encourage: 我相信你的判断 (wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ de pànduàn).
- Feedback: sandwich + question + co-construction.
- Steps: (1) acknowledge strengths, (2) ask a question, (3) suggest with 调整 (tiáozhěng), (4) invite discussion.
- AVOID 改 (gǎi) → use 调整 (tiáozhěng).
objectivesEn: Tell apart 导师 (dialogue) vs 师傅 (technical)
Invoke 我陪你一起摸索
Prefer 调整 to 改 in feedback
Use the magic self-correction question

cecr-c22-conversation-m6.introTitleEn: 我个人的观察是 + 软实力/话语权
cecr-c22-conversation-m6.introContentEn:
In intercultural dialogue, NEVER generalize with '中国人都… (Zhōngguó rén dōu…)' — prefer '很多中国人 (hěn duō Zhōngguó rén)' + '我个人的观察是 X (wǒ gèrén de guānchá shì X)'. WARNING: 话语权 (huàyǔquán) overused sounds paranoid; in speech, prefer 影响力 (yǐngxiǎnglì).

- Intercultural dialogue: 在中国，X 通常被视为 Y，而在西方可能不同 (zài Zhōngguó, X tōngcháng bèi shìwéi Y, ér zài xīfāng kěnéng bùtóng).
- Conclude: 跨文化理解需要时间和耐心 (kuà wénhuà lǐjiě xūyào shíjiān hé nàixīn).
- Soft power: 软实力 (ruǎnshílì), 文化输出 (wénhuà shūchū), 国际形象 (guójì xíngxiàng), 话语权 (huàyǔquán).
- 中国正在努力构建自己的话语体系 (Zhōngguó zhèngzài nǔlì gòujiàn zìjǐ de huàyǔ tǐxì).
- Examples: 孔子学院 (Kǒngzǐ Xuéyuàn), TikTok, 哪吒 (Nézhā), 原神 (Yuánshén), 李子柒 (Lǐ Zǐqī).
- Limits: 西方对中国的认知仍存在偏见 (xīfāng duì Zhōngguó de rènzhī réng cúnzài piānjiàn).
objectivesEn: Avoid '中国人都' (generalization)
Invoke 我个人的观察是
Tell apart 话语权 (formal) vs 影响力 (spoken)
Cite 孔子学院/原神/李子柒 as soft power

cecr-c22-conversation-m7.introTitleEn: 在效率和隐私之间找平衡 + 山高水长，后会有期
cecr-c22-conversation-m7.introContentEn:
For a professional farewell after several years in China, the ULTIMATE chengyu is 山高水长，后会有期 (shān gāo shuǐ cháng, hòuhuì yǒuqī) (mountains high and waters long, we'll meet again) — a guaranteed emotional effect.

- AI debate: 人工智能 (réngōng zhìnéng), 算法 (suànfǎ), 监控 (jiānkòng), 隐私 (yǐnsī), 伦理 (lúnlǐ).
- Neutral/centrist phrase: 在效率和隐私之间，我们需要找到平衡 (zài xiàolǜ hé yǐnsī zhījiān, wǒmen xūyào zhǎodào pínghéng).
- 算法不是中立的 (suànfǎ bùshì zhōnglì de).
- Framework: 个人信息保护法 (gèrén xìnxī bǎohù fǎ) (PIPL, 2021, China's GDPR).
- Conclude: 技术发展需要伦理边界 (jìshù fāzhǎn xūyào lúnlǐ biānjiè).
- Farewell: 我有一件事要告诉大家 (wǒ yǒu yī jiàn shì yào gàosu dàjiā) → 经过深思熟虑，我决定 X (jīngguò shēnsī shúlǜ, wǒ juédìng X) → 这些年，承蒙各位的关照和帮助 (zhèxiē nián, chéngméng gèwèi de guānzhào hé bāngzhù) → 即使离开，我们的友谊不会变 (jíshǐ líkāi, wǒmen de yǒuyì bù huì biàn).
objectivesEn: Invoke 在效率和隐私之间找平衡
Cite 个人信息保护法 (PIPL)
Master 承蒙各位的关照
Conclude a farewell with 山高水长，后会有期

cecr-c22-nuances-m1.introTitleEn: Time in 4 dimensions + 'to cross' in 4 flavors
cecr-c22-nuances-m1.introContentEn: 时间 (shíjiān, time) ≠ 时候 (shíhou, moment) ≠ 时刻 (shíkè, a crucial instant — 关键时刻) ≠ 时机 (shíjī, an opportune moment — 抓住时机). '抓住时机 (zhuāzhù shíjī)' = a business combo to praise a decision ('这是抓住了时机' > '做对了'). To cross: 通过 (tōngguò, to pass through / 通过提案) ≠ 经过 (jīngguò, to pass by a place/period — 经过几年的研究) ≠ 经历 (jīnglì, to live an experience — 经历了困难时期) ≠ 经由 (jīngyóu, via — 经由香港转机). The grammar is in the NATURE of what you cross.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 时间/时候/时刻/时机
Invoke 抓住时机 professionally
Choose 通过/经过/经历/经由
Adapt to the nature of the crossing

cecr-c22-nuances-m2.introContentEn:
The classical structure 一 (yī) + verb + 而 (ér) + result is very productive in elevated speech: 一笑而过 (yī xiào ér guò), 一去不返 (yī qù bù fǎn), 一发不可收拾 (yī fā bù kě shōushí), 一以贯之 (yī yǐ guàn zhī). To praise a mentor's consistency: '您 X 年来一以贯之，令人敬佩 (nín X nián lái yī yǐ guàn zhī, lìng rén jìngpèi)' (the ultimate compliment for moral consistency). Essential numbered chengyu covering 80% of daily elevated emotional situations:

- 一鼓作气 (yìgǔ-zuòqì) (in one push, exhorting to finish).
- 三思而行 (sān sī ér xíng) (think before acting, a caution).
- 五湖四海 (wǔhú-sìhǎi) (from all over the world — 来自五湖四海).
- 九牛二虎之力 (jiǔ niú èr hǔ zhī lì) (费了九牛二虎之力才完成 — took a huge effort to finish).
objectivesEn: Master the 一…而… structure
Cite 一以贯之 to praise consistency
Invoke 三思而行 for caution
Use 九牛二虎之力 for a huge effort

cecr-c22-nuances-m3.introTitleEn: Seizing the moment + mastering critical homophones
cecr-c22-nuances-m3.introContentEn:
To seize: 附 (fù) < 顺 (shùn, in passing, spoken — 顺便) < 趁 (chèn) < 借 (jiè, formal — 借此机会). '借此机会 X (jiè cǐ jīhuì X)' = a UNIVERSAL formula in elevated speech (10x more powerful than '我想 X'). Homophones lǐ/lì: 礼 (lǐ) ≠ 理 (lǐ) ≠ 立 (lì) ≠ 力 (lì) ≠ 利 (lì). Radical-based mnemonic: 礼 (lǐ) = altar+offering, 理 (lǐ) = polishing jade, 立 (lì, to stand), 力 (lì, strength), 利 (lì, benefit).

- C2.2 = ZERO confusion on these characters.
objectivesEn: Rank 附/顺/趁/借
Master 借此机会 in speech
Tell apart 礼/理/立/力/利
Read the radicals to discriminate

cecr-c22-nuances-m4.introContentEn:
近 (jìn, near in time/space) / 远 (yuǎn) / 邻 (lín) / 临 (lín, about to / facing — 临海, 临时, 临阵磨枪 chengyu). 临 (lín) implies TIME, 邻 (lín) implies SPACE. Repetition: 复 (fù, 恢复) < 重 (zhòng, 重写) < 再 (zài, 再说一遍) ≠ 又 (yòu, PAST or habit — 又下雨了). ULTRA-classic mistake: '我又来了 (wǒ yòu lái le)' vs '我再来 (wǒ zài lái)'.

- Mastering this distinction = advanced precision.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 近/远/邻/临 (space vs time)
Recognize 临阵磨枪
Choose 再 (future) vs 又 (past)
Rank 复/重/再/又

cecr-c22-nuances-m5.introContentEn:
终于 (zhōngyú, relief after waiting — 我终于到了) ≠ 终究 (zhōngjiū, 真相终究会大白, a proverb of reassurance) ≠ 毕竟 (bìjìng, concession — 他毕竟还是个孩子) ≠ 究竟 (jiūjìng, insistent inquiry — 究竟发生了什么?). Certain: 一定 (yídìng) < 必定 (bìdìng) < 必然 (bìrán) < 势必 (shìbì, inevitable by dynamics — 这种政策势必引发不满).

- 势必 X (shìbì X) = a C2.2 signal of a serious analyst in a political/economic editorial.
objectivesEn: Tell apart 终于/终究/毕竟/究竟
Recite 真相终究会大白
Rank 一定 → 必定 → 必然 → 势必
Invoke 势必 in political analysis

cecr-c22-nuances-m6.introTitleEn: Final particles (native speech) + addressing a group (register)
cecr-c22-nuances-m6.introContentEn: Final particles: 啊 (a) / 呢 (ne) / 吧 (ba, a suggestion, softens an order) / 嘛 (ma, obviousness — '他是你哥哥嘛') / 哟 (yō). Without particles, your Chinese sounds FLAT and foreign. 嘛 (ma) = a very Chinese ORAL marker. Addressing a group: 大家 (dàjiā) < 各位 (gèwèi, formal, respectful — 各位老师) < 诸位 (zhūwèi, 诸位来宾) < 列位 (lièwèi). In an official speech, open with 各位领导，各位同仁 (gèwèi lǐngdǎo, gèwèi tóngrén); reserve 大家 (dàjiā) for the conclusion ('谢谢大家').
objectivesEn: Master 啊/呢/吧/嘛/哟 in speech
Use 嘛 for camaraderie
Rank 大家/各位/诸位
Open formally with 各位 + close with 谢谢大家

cecr-c22-nuances-m7.introContentEn: Chengyu of comparison: 形影不离 (xíngyǐng-bùlí, inseparable), 唇齿相依 (chún chǐ xiāng yī, interdependent), 千差万别 (qiān chà wàn bié, vastly different). '现在的消费者口味千差万别 (xiànzài de xiāofèizhě kǒuwèi qiān chà wàn bié)' > '很多种 (hěn duō zhǒng)'. Poetic reduplications: 渐渐 (jiànjiàn) / 缓缓 (huǎnhuǎn) / 默默 (mòmò, silently — '您 X 年来默默地付出，让人敬佩', the ultimate compliment for a humble mentor) / 悠悠 (yōuyōu) / 茫茫 (mángmáng). 李清照 (Lǐ Qīngzhào) opens 《声声慢》 with 7 consecutive reduplications. Mastering 5-10 reduplications = a signal of maximum emotional LITERARY LEVEL at C2.2.
objectivesEn: Invoke 形影不离/唇齿相依/千差万别
Use 默默 to praise a quiet effort
Master 5+ poetic reduplications
Evoke 李清照 and the 7 reduplications
